title: Xiaomi Electric Scooter 4 Ultra
summary: Flagship urban mobility with dual suspension, 70 km range, and a 940W motor that turns rough city streets into smooth sailing.
body:
Xiaomi's Electric Scooter 4 Ultra represents the apex of the brand's commuter-focused engineering, built for riders who refuse to compromise between range, comfort, and portability. At its core sits a 940W peak brushless motor that delivers sustained 25 km/h (15.5 mph) cruising speed with enough torque to handle 20% inclines without bogging down — a common failure point for lesser scooters that lose momentum on bridges and overpasses. The 561Wh battery pack, managed by an intelligent BMS that monitors cell temperature and voltage in real time, pushes range to 70 km (43.5 miles) under optimal conditions, enough for a week of urban commuting between charges.

What separates the 4 Ultra from Xiaomi's own 4 Pro and the broader market is its dual suspension system: a front fork paired with a rear shock absorber that soaks up potholes, cobblestones, and cracked pavement that rigid-frame competitors transmit directly to the rider's wrists and spine. The 10-inch self-healing pneumatic tires add another layer of isolation, using a gel-lined inner chamber that seals punctures up to 3.5mm without deflating — critical for riders navigating construction zones and debris-strewn bike lanes. The aircraft-grade aluminum frame folds in under three seconds to a compact package that fits in car trunks and under desks, secured by a dual-locking stem mechanism that eliminates the wobble and flex common in single-lock designs.

The Xiaomi Home app connects via Bluetooth to deliver real-time speed, battery percentage, ride history, and over-the-air firmware updates, plus integrated Find My Scooter tracking and remote locking for security. A regenerative braking system feeds energy back into the battery during deceleration, working in tandem with a front electronic brake and rear disc brake to bring the 22.5 kg scooter to a controlled stop from full speed in under 4 meters. For commuters who measure their vehicle in kilometers per charge rather than liters per 100 km, the 4 Ultra is Xiaomi's most capable answer yet.

title: 2027 Genesis G70
summary: Sharp styling, a driver-focused cockpit, and turbocharged performance make the G70 the most exciting sedan in its class.
body:
Genesis has been on an extraordinary trajectory since it launched as a standalone luxury brand, and the G70 remains its most driver-focused expression — a compact sports sedan that challenges German rivals on their own terms and wins more often than anyone expected. The 2027 model receives revised suspension tuning that sharpens steering response without destroying ride quality, a balance that BMW and Mercedes both struggle with at this price point. The 2.0-liter turbocharged four-cylinder produces 300 horsepower in Sport trim, and the way it delivers power — with a strong mid-range surge and a satisfying intake note — makes it genuinely fun to drive.

The interior has always been the G70's most underappreciated quality, and the 2027 update elevates it further with quilted leather options, a new 14.5-inch curved infotainment display, and ambient lighting that can be customized across sixteen zones. Genesis's five-year complimentary maintenance program remains one of the best ownership perks in the luxury segment. The G70 isn't just a compelling alternative to the BMW 3 Series — in several meaningful ways, it's the better car.

title: Santa Cruz Classic Dot Complete
summary: Santa Cruz's flagship complete skateboard pairs the brand's iconic Screaming Hand graphic with a beginner-friendly 7-ply build, making it one of the most enduring sellers in skate shop history.
body:
The Classic Dot Complete isn't chasing a trend — it's built around graphics that have anchored Santa Cruz's identity since the mid-1980s. Jim Phillips' Screaming Hand, created in 1985, remains one of the best-selling graphics in the company's catalog, and it still shows up on this complete decades after Santa Cruz first put it on a deck. Before the Screaming Hand, Phillips' Rob Roskopp series held that best-seller title through the late '80s, which tells you something about how long Santa Cruz has been getting this formula right: pair a legendary graphic with a deck built to actually take a beating.

Unlike Santa Cruz's premium VX or Powerply lines, the Classic Dot Complete sticks to a straightforward 7-ply maple or birch build, high-rebound urethane wheels, and precision steel bearings — nothing exotic, just a reliable, ready-to-ride setup. That simplicity is exactly why it's remained a go-to recommendation for first-time skaters for generations, while still carrying enough heritage cred that longtime riders pick it up for the nostalgia alone. It's less a single product than a five-decade institution that happens to come fully assembled.

title: Wavestorm 8ft Classic Surfboard
summary: The soft-top foam board that introduces more beginners to surfing than any other single model, Wavestorm's Classic remains the best-selling longboard-style surfboard in the US market.
body:
Wavestorm didn't set out to make the highest-performance board on the water — it set out to make the easiest one to actually get on the water in the first place, and that single-minded focus has made the Classic 8ft the most commercially dominant surfboard in the country. It consistently tops Amazon's longboard surfboard bestseller rankings, a feat no premium fiberglass shaper comes close to matching, simply because it removes every barrier a first-time surfer faces: no wax needed thanks to the textured slick-bottom deck, a leash and multiple fins already included in the box, and a soft foam construction that turns inevitable beginner wipeouts into non-events instead of injuries.

What makes the Classic more than just a cheap starter board is how long it stays useful. Its buoyant foam core and generous length make it forgiving enough for a first paddle-out, but plenty of casual surfers hang onto theirs for years as a small-wave cruiser long after they've bought a 'real' performance shortboard. Surf shops and rental outfits lean on it for exactly that durability, and the brand has leaned into its own ubiquity with novelty collabs (Hello Kitty, Fender) that turn a utilitarian foamie into something with actual brand cachet. It's not the board serious surfers aspire to own — it's the board that made them surfers in the first place.

title: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra
summary: The ultimate Android flagship with a refined S Pen and next-gen AI features.
body:
Samsung's Galaxy S25 Ultra is the most complete Android smartphone ever made — a bold claim, but one that the device's specification sheet and real-world performance consistently support. The titanium frame is thinner and lighter than its predecessor while feeling more premium in hand, the 6.9-inch Dynamic AMOLED display hits a peak brightness of 2,600 nits with a 1-120Hz adaptive refresh rate, and the Snapdragon 8 Elite chipset inside is frighteningly fast in every benchmark and daily use scenario. The S Pen integration remains unique in the market, offering a pressure-sensitive stylus experience that creative professionals and note-takers genuinely rely upon.

Samsung's Galaxy AI platform has matured significantly for 2026, with Circle to Search, Live Translate, and the new Sketch to Image feature all performing with a reliability that makes them daily-use tools rather than party tricks. The camera system — a 200MP primary, 50MP periscope telephoto at 5x, and 10MP ultrawide — is exceptional across virtually all shooting conditions, with night photography in particular standing out as class-leading. Battery life easily clears a full day of heavy use. This is the phone for Android users who want the absolute best.

title: 2027 Toyota RAV4
summary: America's best-selling SUV delivers reliability, comfort, and value in every trim.
body:
Toyota's RAV4 didn't become America's best-selling SUV by accident — it got there through relentless refinement of the things that matter most to real buyers: dependability, comfort, and a total cost of ownership that makes financial sense over a five or ten year horizon. The RAV4's powertrain lineup covers all the bases, from the efficient 2.5-liter naturally-aspirated four-cylinder in the base XLE to the plug-in hybrid Prime that delivers 42 miles of all-electric range before the combustion engine ever wakes up.

The interior balances practicality and comfort in a way that feels considered rather than compromised. Storage solutions are abundant, the infotainment interface responds quickly to inputs, and the available JBL audio system delivers sound quality that justifies its price premium. Toyota's warranty coverage and dealer network density are unmatched in the segment, meaning ownership peace of mind extends well beyond the purchase. In a world of increasingly complicated choices, the RAV4's straightforward excellence is genuinely refreshing.

title: 2027 Nissan Rogue
summary: Spacious cabin, intuitive tech, and a competitive price for growing families.
body:
Nissan's Rogue punches well above its price class in the areas families care about most, delivering a spacious, well-appointed interior that feels more premium than its sticker price suggests. The three-zone climate control, available heated rear seats, and generous legroom in the second row all speak to a manufacturer that has genuinely listened to what family SUV buyers prioritize. The Rogue's cargo area, at 74.1 cubic feet with the rear seats folded, is among the largest in the compact SUV class.

Nissan's ProPilot Assist remains one of the most capable driver assistance systems available at this price point, combining adaptive cruise control with lane centering that functions confidently on the highway. The infotainment system has been upgraded with a 12.3-inch touchscreen and an improved voice recognition system that responds accurately to natural language commands. For buyers working with a real-world family budget who refuse to sacrifice space or technology, the Rogue consistently delivers one of the most compelling value propositions in the segment.

title: UFC 329: McGregor vs. Holloway 2
summary: Conor McGregor ends a five-year Octagon absence against BMF champion Max Holloway in the marquee bout of International Fight Week.
body:
UFC 329 headlines the promotion's annual International Fight Week on July 11, 2026, at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, and the main event alone justifies the hype: Conor McGregor, out of competition since a broken leg ended his UFC 264 fight in July 2021, returns to face Max Holloway in a welterweight rematch of their August 2013 featherweight bout, which McGregor won by unanimous decision. Holloway enters as the significant betting favorite, riding a 5-3 stretch since McGregor's last appearance that includes a BMF title defense over Justin Gaethje and wins over Yair Rodriguez, Arnold Allen, and Dustin Poirier, while McGregor looks to reverse a 1-3 skid dating back to 2018. The card's build has been pure McGregor theater — trash talk, wardrobe stunts, and a five-year layoff nobody can fully explain away — but Holloway's activity and durability make him no gimme opponent for a fighter shaking off that much rust.

The rest of the pay-per-view card carries real stakes of its own. Paddy Pimblett meets Benoit Saint Denis at lightweight in a stylistic clash tailor-made for violence, Cory Sandhagen and Mario Bautista battle at bantamweight with divisional positioning on the line, and Lone'er Kavanagh faces Brandon Royval at flyweight. Prelims add King Green vs. Terrance McKinney, a virtual lock for fireworks given both men's finish rates, plus Robert Whittaker vs. Nikita Krylov at light heavyweight and Gable Steveson's continued heavyweight development against Elisha Ellison. Early prelims round out a stacked thirteen-bout card. The event streams live on Paramount+, with early prelims at 5:00 PM ET, prelims at 7:00 PM ET, and the main card starting at 9:00 PM ET.

title: GLM-5.2 Matches Claude Mythos 5
summary: When Washington pulled the plug on Anthropic's most powerful models, a Beijing lab answered within 24 hours with a free, uncontrolled model that beat it outright — and the markets noticed instantly.
body:
On June 12, 2026, the US Department of Commerce ordered Anthropic to cut off global access to Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5, its two most capable models, citing export control concerns. It was the kind of move designed to protect a strategic advantage. It lasted less than a day before the strategy collapsed.

On June 13, Beijing-based Z.ai (formerly Zhipu AI) released GLM-5.2 — not to a waitlist, not behind a paywall, but as fully open MIT-licensed weights that anyone on earth could download, run locally, modify, and redistribute. Within hours it had claimed the top spot on a leading agentic reasoning benchmark, beating the very Fable 5 the US had just locked away. It ran at roughly 300 tokens per second. It cost a fraction of its American rival. And nobody in Washington could switch it off, because there was nothing to switch off — the weights were already everywhere.

The numbers behind GLM-5.2 are genuinely staggering: a 744-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with a 1-million-token context window, priced around $1.40 per million input tokens against Claude Opus's $5 and GPT-5.5's $5 — undercutting the US flagships by three to four times while trading blows with them on coding and long-horizon agent tasks. Zhipu's Hong Kong-listed stock responded the way you'd expect a company to react to suddenly winning a geopolitical argument by accident: shares jumped as much as 48% in a single session, pushing the company's market cap past HK$1 trillion, with JPMorgan and Bank of America both racing to slap buy ratings on the stock.

The line that spread across developer circles said it plainly: you cannot export-control your way out of open source. A restriction built to contain one company's frontier model did nothing to stop a rival lab, operating outside US jurisdiction, from giving the capability away globally for free — and arguably accelerated Chinese AI's credibility with developers who'd never have looked twice at a Beijing lab's model otherwise.

Anthropic, for its part, spent the next two and a half weeks working the problem from the inside rather than fighting it in public. By June 30, the Commerce Department reversed course and lifted the export controls; Fable 5 and Mythos 5 came back online globally on July 1. The official reasoning that emerged afterward was almost anticlimactic: Anthropic's own testing reportedly showed that Opus 4.8, GPT-5.5, and Zhipu's own Kimi K2.7 could all reproduce the same exploit that triggered the ban in the first place — meaning Fable 5 never had a unique dangerous capability worth quarantining. The government had blocked a car for having a working engine, in a world where every other car on the lot already had one.

What's left in the aftermath is a genuinely new dynamic in the AI race. Anthropic used the standoff to pivot toward the US government rather than away from it, co-developing a shared jailbreak risk-scoring framework with Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, and publicly pushing for that framework to bind every frontier lab equally — not just the one that got banned. Meanwhile, developers who switched to GLM-5.2 or Kimi K2.7 during the 19-day blackout now have three weeks of real production data on cost, latency, and quality that no benchmark table can replace, and many are keeping the open-weight stack as a permanent option rather than snapping back to Claude the moment access returned. The ban was supposed to protect an American advantage. Instead it handed the rest of the world a free, faster, uncontrolled alternative — and proved, in real time, that in an open-source world, the fastest way to lose a lead is to try legislating it shut.

title: RAF Georgia: Dvalishvili vs. Cejudo
summary: Merab Dvalishvili stormed back from an 8-0 deficit to beat Henry Cejudo 11-8 in Real American Freestyle's first event outside the United States, while Arman Tsarukyan opened the card with a dominant technical fall over Kuat Khamitov.
body:
RAF Georgia marked Real American Freestyle's international debut, staged at Tbilisi Arena in front of a home crowd for the promotion's biggest Georgian star. Henry Cejudo, the 2008 Olympic gold medalist and former two-division UFC champion, came out fast, exploding into a high gut-wrench and building an 8-0 lead that put him one takedown from a technical-fall finish. Dvalishvili weathered it, chipped away with a single-leg in the second period, and then closed the match on a 9-0 run in the final minute, finishing 11-8. It's his second straight win over Cejudo, following his MMA victory over him at UFC 298 in February 2024, and it comes months after Dvalishvili lost his UFC bantamweight title to Petr Yan at UFC 323 in December 2025.

The card opened with Arman Tsarukyan, one of the UFC's top-ranked lightweights, taking an 11-0 technical fall over Kuat Khamitov to push his RAF record to 7-0 for the year. He isn't resting on it — Tsarukyan is already booked for RAF 11 in Milwaukee just one week later, on July 18, opposite Colby Covington. Elsewhere on the card, Kyle Snyder retained his light heavyweight belt with a pinfall over Abdulrashid Sadulaev, and Kyle Dake defended his cruiserweight title with a shutout points win over Vladimeri Gamkrelidze.

The result underlines RAF's pitch as a crossover platform for UFC-caliber fighters to compete in folkstyle-adjacent wrestling outside the octagon — and Tbilisi's turnout for a hometown hero suggests the international expansion has an audience.

title: GPT-5.6 Comes Out and Rivals Claude Fable 5
summary: OpenAI's newest model family — Sol, Terra, and Luna — rolled out broadly this week after a government-mandated preview period, with OpenAI claiming Sol edges out Anthropic's Fable 5 on coding benchmarks while using less than half the tokens.
body:
GPT-5.6 first appeared on June 26 as a restricted preview limited to a small group of partners whose participation OpenAI shared with the U.S. government, part of a broader tightening around frontier model releases following a June executive order on AI. OpenAI said at the time it didn't believe government-gated access should become the long-term default, and after roughly two weeks of coordination it released the models publicly on July 9, alongside a new voice model line called GPT-Live. The staggered rollout mirrors what Anthropic went through the same month, when Commerce Department export controls forced a temporary suspension of Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 before access was restored on July 1.

The family comes in three tiers: Sol, the flagship; Terra, a mid-tier model OpenAI says is competitive with GPT-5.5 at half the cost; and Luna, the budget option. On OpenAI's own Coding Agent Index, the company claims Sol scores 80 — 2.8 points above Fable 5 — while taking less than half the time and costing about a third less per task. CEO Sam Altman told CNBC that Sol is 54% more token-efficient on agentic coding work specifically. OpenAI is also positioning 5.6 as its strongest cybersecurity model to date, citing gains on exploit-research benchmarks, which is part of why the government asked for the phased release in the first place — the system card notes Sol identified real bugs and exploitation primitives in evaluations against Chromium and Firefox, though it didn't autonomously chain them into a full working exploit under test conditions.

Early outside reaction has been mixed rather than a clean OpenAI win. Investor Matt Shumer said Fable was noticeably better across nearly every task he tried despite GPT-5.6 being impressive, and Every CEO Dan Shipper compared GPT-5.6 to a Porsche next to what he called Fable's 'warp drive.' Pricing lands at $5/$30 per million input/output tokens for Sol, $2.50/$15 for Terra, and $1/$6 for Luna — positioning the family to compete directly with Anthropic's Mythos-tier models on both capability and cost.

title: PFL Belfast: Kelly vs Wilson
summary: PFL touches down in Belfast for a ferocious lightweight showdown.
body:
Professional Fighters League's visit to Belfast brings one of Europe's most passionate combat sports audiences to a fight card that has genuine stakes attached to every bout. The main event lightweight showdown between Kelly and Wilson carries playoff implications that give both fighters compelling reasons beyond pride to leave everything in the cage. Belfast has produced some of MMA's most beloved characters, and the hometown crowd's energy will be a factor from the first walkout to the final bell.

Kelly's ground game is the foundation of his approach — a control-oriented grappler who drains opponents' energy with relentless pressure and works methodically toward submissions. Wilson is the more explosive of the two, with a striking arsenal that has produced highlight-reel finishes at every level of competition. The stylistic clash between a grinder and a finisher is one of MMA's most reliably entertaining formats, and the Belfast crowd will be firmly behind their man from the opening exchange. PFL's visit to Northern Ireland is the kind of moment that grows the sport's European footprint in a meaningful way.

title: Conor McGregor's UFC 329 Comeback Ends in Seconds
summary: A leaping kick in the opening moments led to a knee injury that abruptly ended McGregor's return.
body:
Conor McGregor's long-awaited return to the Octagon lasted just 69 seconds. Facing Max Holloway in the UFC 329 main event at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, McGregor threw a leaping kick almost immediately after the opening bell, appearing to compromise his knee in the process. He was unable to regain his footing, and referee Mike Beltran quickly stepped in to stop the fight, bringing a deflating end to a bout that had been years in the making.

The abrupt finish has since spawned speculation online about whether the injury actually predated the fight. Footage circulating on social media — including video posted by the UFC itself — appears to show McGregor favoring his knee while removing his shoes during his pre-fight equipment check, well before he ever walked to the cage. That has fueled a wave of conspiracy talk questioning whether the leaping kick was truly the moment the injury occurred, or simply the moment it became impossible to hide.

McGregor left the arena quickly afterward, skipping his usual in-cage interview and departing still in his fight gear. Neither he nor UFC president Dana White has commented publicly on the injury, leaving open questions about his health and whether this outing marks the end of his time in the Octagon.

title: Microsoft Cuts 3,200 Jobs From Xbox in Massive Restructuring
summary: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced sweeping layoffs and studio spinoffs as the division undergoes its most significant reset in company history.
body:
Microsoft's Xbox division is undergoing its most sweeping restructuring in company history. On July 6, 2026, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced that roughly 3,200 jobs — about 20% of the division's staff — will be eliminated over the course of fiscal year 2026, with the first wave of 1,600 layoffs taking effect immediately. The cuts were part of a broader Microsoft-wide reduction of 4,800 roles, or 2.1% of the company's global workforce.

In a blunt internal memo, Sharma told employees the division's finances were unsustainable: "Our business today is not healthy. We are operating on margins that are 3-10x lower than those of comparable platform and publishing businesses." She pointed to a smaller console install base, rising costs tied to the memory-chip squeeze from AI data-center demand, and Game Pass and multi-platform investments that failed to grow as quickly as hoped.

Alongside the layoffs, four studios — Ninja Theory, Undead Labs, Compulsion Games, and Double Fine Productions — are being moved to outside management, while Microsoft works to sell or spin off a fifth, Arkane Studios in France. Despite the scale of the cuts, no previously announced games have been canceled and no studios have been outright shuttered. It marks the fifth major wave of Microsoft layoffs in the past three years, and comes as the company pours upwards of $190 billion into AI infrastructure and data centers for 2027.

title: Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max
summary: Titanium design meets breakthrough A19 Pro chip and revolutionary camera system.
body:
Apple's iPhone 17 Pro Max represents the most significant generational leap in the Pro line in several years, arriving with a refined titanium chassis that is lighter and more comfortable in hand than any previous large-format iPhone. The A19 Pro chip delivers performance gains that go well beyond incremental improvement — machine learning tasks that previously required a cloud connection now execute locally in real time, and the sustained performance under thermal load has been dramatically improved by a new internal architecture. The display, a 6.9-inch Super Retina XDR panel with ProMotion, is the finest screen Apple has ever shipped.

The camera system has been completely redesigned for 2026, with a 48MP primary sensor featuring a larger pixel size for dramatically improved low-light performance, a 48MP ultrawide with autofocus, and a 12MP 5x periscope telephoto that now supports macro photography. Apple Intelligence features — the AI suite built into iOS 19 — are more capable and more integrated than ever, handling tasks from email summarization to real-time photo editing with a naturalness that sets the standard for on-device AI. If you use your phone as your primary camera and computing device, the iPhone 17 Pro Max is the best tool ever made for that purpose.

title: 2027 GMC Sierra 1500
summary: Bold styling, rugged capability, and a premium interior redefine the full-size truck.
body:
The GMC Sierra 1500 has carved out a distinct identity in the crowded full-size truck segment by positioning itself as the premium alternative to the Chevrolet Silverado it shares a platform with. The MultiPro tailgate — a six-function engineering marvel that transforms the truck bed into a work platform, a step system, and a secondary cargo hauler — remains one of the most genuinely useful truck innovations in recent memory. The interior on upper trims is legitimately luxury-car quality, with available Super Cruise hands-free driving technology that works on over 400,000 miles of compatible roads.

Towing and payload figures are competitive across the engine lineup, with the available Duramax diesel producing 277 horsepower and an enormous 460 lb-ft of torque for drivers who regularly pull heavy loads. The AT4 off-road variant adds a factory lift, Multimatic DSSV dampers, and underbody protection for buyers who take their Sierra beyond paved roads. GMC has successfully differentiated the Sierra as a truck for professionals who want capability without sacrificing refinement, and the 2027 model makes that case more convincingly than ever.

title: 2027 BMW 2 Series: Familiar Formula, New M2 xDrive on the Way
summary: BMW's smallest and sportiest lineup carries over largely unchanged, but a new all-wheel-drive M2 trim is set to headline the year.
body:
The 2027 BMW 2 Series arrives without a major overhaul, continuing into its second generation with the same coupe and Gran Coupe body styles that have defined the lineup since 2021. The Coupe keeps its compact two-door proportions — triangular headlights, small kidney grilles, an angular front fascia, and oval taillights — while the Gran Coupe offers a more streamlined four-door take on the same platform. Inside, both variants retain BMW's sloping dashboard design with large integrated displays, triangular air vents, and minimal physical controls; the Coupe pairs a 12.3-inch digital instrument cluster with a 14.9-inch touchscreen, while the Gran Coupe runs a slightly smaller 10.25-inch cluster and 10.7-inch touchscreen.

The engine lineup is expected to carry over as well, with a trio of turbocharged 2.0-liter four-cylinders producing 241, 255, and 312 horsepower, plus a turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-six making 382 horsepower in the M240i. Rear-wheel drive remains standard across the range, with all-wheel drive available.

The headline change for 2027 is reserved for the high-performance M2, which is expected to gain a new xDrive trim — the model's first all-wheel-drive variant. The current M2 runs a twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-six good for 473 horsepower and 406 lb-ft of torque, paired with a standard six-speed manual or optional eight-speed automatic; the new xDrive version is expected to pair its added traction with the automatic gearbox only. Standard safety tech across the lineup should continue to include automatic emergency braking, lane keeping assist, blind spot monitoring, and front and rear parking sensors. BMW hasn't confirmed pricing, but the 2027 lineup is expected to reach dealerships this fall.

title: PFL Austin: Eblen vs. Kasanganay 2
summary: Johnny Eblen and Impa Kasanganay clash for the first interim championship in PFL history in a rematch of a razor-thin split decision.
body:
PFL Austin marks the promotion's first-ever visit to Texas and delivers a historic first: the inaugural interim world title fight in PFL history. Former Bellator middleweight champion Johnny "Pressure" Eblen meets 2023 PFL Light Heavyweight Tournament champion Impa "Tshilobo" Kasanganay for the Interim PFL Middleweight World Championship after reigning champion Costello van Steenis was forced out with injury. The pairing renews a rivalry from the historic PFL vs. Bellator Champions event, where Eblen escaped with a narrow split-decision win that many observers felt could have gone Kasanganay's way. Eblen enters on a first-round submission win over Bryan Battle, while Kasanganay arrives fresh off a first-round knockout of Dalton Rosta, giving both men momentum heading into a fight that will shape the division's championship picture.

The co-main event pits former Bellator bantamweight champion Sergio Pettis against 2024 PFL Europe bantamweight champion Lewis McGrillen, a matchup with real title implications given McGrillen's four-fight win streak and 92% finish rate. Preliminary action adds a lightweight clash between Sergio Cossio and Kolton Englund plus a women's flyweight bout between Andrea Vazquez and Aleksandra Savicheva. PFL Austin streams from Moody Center with prelims at 5:00 PM ET on the ESPN app and the main card airing at 8:00 PM ET on ESPN2.

title: ONE Fight Night 45: Lessei vs. Rabah
summary: American Muay Thai star Luke Lessei faces Algerian powerhouse Mohamed Younes Rabah in a featherweight Muay Thai main event with title implications.
body:
ONE Championship returns to U.S. primetime with ONE Fight Night 45 from Bangkok's iconic Lumpinee Stadium. In the main event, Luke "The Chef" Lessei — one of America's rising Muay Thai stars — looks to rebound from his loss to interim featherweight Muay Thai king Nico Carrillo and break into the world title picture. Standing in his way is "The Eagle" Mohamed Younes Rabah, a 6-foot-2 Algerian powerhouse who has been near-flawless in his professional career and owns a victory over a former ONE World Title challenger. The winner positions themselves for a shot at featherweight Muay Thai gold.

The card also features the returns of Scottish knockout artist Stephen "El Matador" Irvine, Malaysian sensation Jihin "Shadow Cat" Radzuan, Filipino phenom Lito "Thunder Kid" Adiwang, and three-division Lumpinee Stadium World Champion Suakim Pongsuphan PK. With 9 fights spanning MMA, Muay Thai, kickboxing, and submission grappling, ONE Fight Night 45 broadcasts live on Amazon Prime Video at 9:00 PM ET.

title: Kimi K3
summary: Moonshot AI drops a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight model that trades blows with the biggest closed-source systems in the world.
body:
Moonshot AI released Kimi K3 on July 16, positioning it as the largest open-weight AI model ever built — roughly 2.8 trillion total parameters, nearly triple the size of its predecessor, K2.6. The model introduces two architectural innovations developed in-house: Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), a hybrid linear attention mechanism, and Attention Residuals (AttnRes), a drop-in replacement for standard residual connections that delivers consistent scaling gains. It also ships with a 1-million-token context window and reasoning switched on by default, which Moonshot calls 'thinking mode.'

On independent benchmarks, K3 landed fourth overall among frontier models, trailing only the very top closed-source systems, and it took the number one spot on Arena's Frontend Code leaderboard — a 17-place jump from K2.6. Pricing undercuts the competition significantly at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, roughly half the cost of comparable Western flagships. The release marks a comeback moment for Moonshot, whose market position had slipped over the past 18 months, and lands just ahead of the 2027 World Artificial Intelligence Conference in Shanghai. Full open weights are expected to publish by July 27.

title: UFC Fight Night: Du Plessis vs. Usman
summary: Former middleweight king Dricus du Plessis meets former welterweight champion Kamaru Usman as the UFC returns to Oklahoma City for the first time in nearly a decade.
body:
UFC Fight Night 281 brings the promotion back to Oklahoma City for the first time since 2017, headlined by a genuine clash of styles: former UFC middleweight champion Dricus du Plessis, one of the division's most dangerous finishers with stoppages in 20 of his 23 career wins, against former welterweight king Kamaru Usman, who is making just his second appearance at 185 pounds in pursuit of two-division history. Du Plessis returns for the first time since losing his title last August and carries notable wins over Sean Strickland, Israel Adesanya, and Robert Whittaker into the fight, while Usman — one of the most dominant welterweights the sport has seen, with victories over Colby Covington, Jorge Masvidal, and Tyron Woodley — looks to prove his suffocating wrestling translates against elite middleweight competition. A statement win for either man reopens the door to title contention in a division still sorting out its next challenger.

The co-main event pits former title challenger Jared Cannonier against surging prospect Christian Leroy Duncan, and the rest of the card is loaded with intriguing action: Kevin Holland faces Jacobe Smith at welterweight, veteran Brad Tavares meets Marc-André Barriault, and Chase Hooper looks to continue building momentum against Mitch Ramirez. The card marks the promotion's debut at Paycom Center and streams entirely on Paramount+, with prelims at 5:00 PM ET and the main card following at 8:00 PM ET.

title: McLaren 788HS
summary: McLaren's most focused supercar yet closes out the 720S super-series legacy in spectacular fashion.
body:
The McLaren 788HS represents the culmination of a supercar bloodline that began with the 720S and continued through the 765LT and 750S. Built by McLaren Special Operations, it's only the third car in McLaren's history to carry the coveted 'High Sport' badge — a designation previously reserved for the 2012 MP4-12C HS and the 2016 675LT MSO HS.

Limited to just 200 coupes and 200 spiders worldwide, every 788HS is individually configured by MSO, giving buyers extensive personalization options and ensuring no two cars are quite alike. It's less a swan song than a victory lap for the super-series formula McLaren has spent over a decade refining — immediate throttle response, an intense soundtrack, and the kind of driver connection the brand has built its identity around.

title: Suzuki Hayabusa
summary: The Ultimate Sportbike returns for 2026, refining two decades of dominance with sharper electronics and a smoother ride.
body:
The Suzuki Hayabusa continues its reign as motorcycling's Ultimate Sportbike, a title it has held for the better part of two decades. The 2027 edition is driven by a muscular yet refined 1,340cc inline four-cylinder engine, fed by Ride-by-Wire electronic throttle bodies with dual fuel injectors and Suzuki Ram Air Direct (SRAD) intakes for maximum airflow at speed. It's housed within a modernized, superbike-caliber twin-spar aluminum chassis that balances razor precision with unmatched composure.

Performance is managed by an innovative suite of electronic rider aids, including updated Launch Control and Power Mode Selector settings for 2027 that make low-throttle torque more distinct, plus Smart Cruise Control that stays active through gear shifts. The Hayabusa's iconic aerodynamic silhouette — inspired by the peregrine falcon, the world's fastest animal — remains instantly recognizable, refined through extensive wind tunnel testing with sculpted vents, air diffusers, and a sophisticated LED lighting system. Riders and admirers alike still know exactly what they're looking at the moment it comes into view.

title: RAF 11
summary: The rivalry finally hits the mat as Arman Tsarukyan and Colby Covington collide for RAF's new Crossover Championship.
body:
Months of back-and-forth trash talk finally culminate tonight as Arman Tsarukyan and Colby Covington headline RAF 11 from UW-Milwaukee Panther Arena. The matchup was long blocked by an unwritten rule preventing active UFC fighters from competing against each other in rival promotions — Covington cleared that hurdle by formally retiring from MMA to return to his wrestling roots, where he was a two-time Pac-10 Champion at Oregon State.

Both men enter unbeaten in RAF: Tsarukyan improved to 5-0 with a first-round technical fall over Mugzy, while Covington has reeled off three straight wins, including a close decision over former UFC middleweight champion Chris Weidman. The winner claims RAF's newly created Crossover Championship, a title designed for athletes making the jump from other combat sports onto the freestyle mat. The co-main event carries its own storyline, with Ben Askren making his RAF debut against Belal Muhammad in his first competitive match since a 2025 double lung transplant.

title: OnePlus 13
summary: Flagship performance at a disruptive price with a stunning AMOLED display.
body:
OnePlus has consistently punched above its weight class in the flagship smartphone market, and the OnePlus 13 is the brand's most complete offering yet — a device that matches or exceeds the specifications of phones costing several hundred dollars more. The 6.82-inch LTPO4 AMOLED display with a 4,500 nit peak brightness is genuinely spectacular, with a ProXDR system that adapts refresh rate from 1Hz to 120Hz based on content type for optimal battery efficiency. The Snapdragon 8 Elite chipset performs exactly as its top-tier positioning suggests.

The Hasselblad camera partnership continues to produce results that demonstrate what happens when a legendary optics company's color science and tuning philosophy is applied to smartphone photography. The primary 50MP sensor captures images with a natural rendering that avoids the over-processed look of several competitors, and the zoom system maintains usable quality through the 6x optical range. The 6,000mAh battery with 100W wired charging is a meaningful advantage over rivals — a 30-minute charge from near-zero produces a full day's use. The OnePlus 13 is the answer for buyers who want flagship everything without the flagship price.

title: Honda Rebel 500
summary: Stripped-back style meets accessible power in Honda's most approachable cruiser.
body:
The Honda Rebel 500 is one of those rare motorcycles that manages to look genuinely cool without trying too hard — the low-slung silhouette, blacked-out components, and clean, uncluttered lines create an aesthetic that appeals to riders across experience levels and age groups. The 471cc parallel-twin engine produces 46 horsepower with a smooth, manageable power delivery that rewards newer riders while remaining engaging enough to hold the interest of more experienced ones. The seating position is naturally low and relaxed without being aggressively forward-leaning.

Honda's build quality shines through every detail of the Rebel 500, from the precision of the switchgear to the smooth operation of the six-speed gearbox. The 2027 model adds Honda Selectable Torque Control as standard, providing an electronic safety net that allows riders to push with more confidence while learning their limits. The customization ecosystem around the Rebel is extensive, with Honda and third-party accessories allowing owners to genuinely personalize their machine. As a first serious motorcycle or an uncomplicated weekend ride, the Rebel 500 is difficult to improve upon.

title: 2027 Toyota Corolla
summary: Reliable, efficient, and refined — the Corolla remains the world's favorite compact.
body:
The Toyota Corolla has sold over 50 million units globally and shows absolutely no signs of losing its appeal — because it continues to deliver the things that made it successful in the first place, just in an increasingly refined package. The 2027 Corolla is sharper in every dimension than its predecessors: the interior is more premium, the driving dynamics have been improved with retuned suspension, and the hybrid powertrain now achieves an astonishing 53 MPG combined without any sacrifice in everyday usability. The sport sedan version has become a legitimate enthusiast option at an accessible price.

Toyota Safety Sense 3.0 is standard across the entire Corolla lineup, bringing pre-collision detection with pedestrian, cyclist, and motorcycle recognition, lane departure alert with active steering correction, and automatic high beam control. The infotainment system has been updated with an 8 or 10.5-inch touchscreen depending on trim, with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto standard throughout. In a world of increasingly complex and expensive vehicles, the Corolla's clear-headed competence feels like a relief. There is a reason it is the best-selling nameplate in automotive history.

title: UFC Fight Night: Brady vs Buckley
summary: Two middleweight strikers ready to steal the show in a must-watch Fight Night main event.
body:
Sean Brady and Joaquin Buckley are two of the most exciting fighters on the UFC's middleweight roster, and their collision in the Fight Night main event carries the genuine potential to be one of the year's best performances. Brady's wrestling-based approach has been increasingly augmented by sharp boxing combinations that make him dangerous whether the fight is on the feet or on the mat, while Buckley's infamous spinning back kick that launched his UFC career was just the beginning of a striking game that has continued to evolve in spectacular fashion.

The tactical question at the heart of this fight is whether Brady can get Buckley down to the mat consistently enough to neutralize his striking advantage, or whether Buckley's ability to create distance and land clean will keep the fight where his power can be most effectively deployed. Fight Night cards live and die by the quality of their main events, and this matchup has all the ingredients to deliver a performance that Fight Night fans will be discussing for months afterward.

title: BKFC 89: Tierney vs Franco
summary: BKFC brings the heat to Palm Desert as Connor Tierney and Rico Franco clash in a welterweight main event with title shot implications.
body:
Connor Tierney has been one of BKFC's most consistent performers in the welterweight division, combining a high punch output with the kind of defensive awareness that keeps him competitive deep into fights when opponents are trying to capitalize on accumulated damage. Rico Franco brings the aggression and power that BKFC main events demand, with a track record of forcing opponents into exchanges that play directly into his strengths. The title shot implications give both fighters concrete motivation beyond the usual competitive drive.

Bare knuckle welterweight matchups have a particular intensity — the weight class produces fighters athletic enough to move and technical enough to be dangerous, but heavy enough that single shots carry genuine fight-ending potential. Palm Desert's indoor venue will create an intimate atmosphere that bare knuckle boxing thrives in, with the crowd close enough to feel every exchange. BKFC 89 shapes up as one of the promotion's stronger 2027 offerings.

title: PFL Washington DC: Jean vs. Musaev
summary: Two undefeated tournament champions collide for the vacant PFL welterweight world title in the nation's capital.
body:
PFL Washington DC delivers a genuine crossroads fight for the welterweight division: undefeated 2025 PFL Welterweight Tournament champion Thad Jean puts his unblemished record on the line against 2024 tournament champion Shamil Musaev for the vacant PFL Welterweight World Championship. The title became open after previous champion Ramazan Kuramagomedov was stripped following an abrupt retirement announcement immediately after winning it. Jean (11-0) captured his tournament crown via one of the toughest paths in the division, including a first-round knockout of Mukhamed Berkhamov, while Musaev (20-1-1) has already proven he belongs among the elite with a knockout win over Logan Storley and two victories over Murad Ramazanov — leaving only the championship itself missing from his résumé.

The rest of the card features hard-hitting action across weight classes: Antônio Carlos Jr. meets Luke Trainer at light heavyweight, Magomed Umalatov battles Ernesto Rodriguez at welterweight, and veteran Tyson Pedro takes on Rafael Xavier. PFL Washington DC marks the promotion's return to the capital for the first time since 2024 and streams from CareFirst Arena, with prelims at 7:00 PM ET on the ESPN app and the main card at 10:00 PM ET on ESPN.

title: UFC Fight Night: Ankalaev vs. Rountree Jr.
summary: Former light heavyweight champion Magomed Ankalaev looks to rebound against surging contender Khalil Rountree Jr. as the UFC returns to Abu Dhabi.
body:
UFC Fight Night 282 lands at Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi on July 25, 2026, marking the promotion's first visit to the venue since UFC 321 in October 2025. Headlining is a light heavyweight showdown between former champion Magomed Ankalaev, back in action for the first time since losing the belt this past October, and Khalil Rountree Jr., a former title challenger who has built momentum as one of the division's most dangerous strikers. Ankalaev enters with a striking accuracy edge and a reputation for suffocating control on the feet and ground, while Rountree's power and durability make this a legitimate crossroads fight for both men's positioning near the top of the light heavyweight rankings.

The co-main event features bantamweight contender Umar Nurmagomedov taking on Mexico's David Martinez, and the card runs deep with notable names across divisions: Rizvan Kuniev meets Tyrell Fortune at heavyweight, Steve Erceg returns at flyweight against Ramazan Temirov, and Ismael Bonfim squares off with Axel Sola at lightweight. With twelve bouts total, the card streams live on Paramount+, with prelims starting at 12:00 PM ET and the main card following at 3:00 PM ET.

title: GMA T50 Final Edition
summary: Gordon Murray Automotive marks the end of the T.50's production run, closing out a 100-car legacy built around one of the greatest naturally aspirated engines ever put in a road car.
body:
The GMA T.50 was never trying to be the fastest car in a straight line — it was built to be the purest, and that's exactly what makes its send-off feel significant. Gordon Murray designed it as a spiritual successor to his own McLaren F1, with a central driving position, a curb weight barely over 2,000 pounds, and a philosophy that treated lightness as the ultimate performance metric in an era obsessed with horsepower figures.

At the heart of it all is a 3.9-liter Cosworth-built V12 that revs to 12,100 rpm — the highest-revving naturally aspirated engine ever fitted to a road car — paired with a six-speed manual gearbox for drivers who still want to do the work themselves. The rear-mounted fan, a nod to the banned Brabham BT46B F1 car Murray also designed, manages airflow and downforce without relying on ugly wings or bulky diffusers. As the 100th and final T.50 comes off the line, it closes out one of the last true analog hypercars built before the industry's full pivot to hybrid and electric power — a car that enthusiasts will point to for decades as proof that mechanical purity and driver engagement never went out of style.

title: PFL MENA 9: Pride of Arabia
summary: PFL heads to the Middle East for another explosive night of international MMA action.
body:
PFL's MENA series has become one of the promotion's most exciting ventures, tapping into a region with enormous untapped appetite for elite combat sports and a growing roster of local talent capable of competing at international level. Pride of Arabia events carry a particular energy — the crowds are passionate, the atmosphere is electric, and the matchmakers have demonstrated a willingness to put MENA-region fighters in meaningful matchups rather than using local talent as promotional window dressing.

The ninth edition of the series arrives at a moment when Middle Eastern MMA is experiencing genuine growth at every level, from grassroots gym culture to professional competition. PFL's investment in the region has accelerated that development, creating opportunities for fighters who previously had limited pathways to international exposure. MENA 9 promises another card that balances star power from PFL's global roster with the emerging talent that makes these events more than just a touring show.

title: 2027 Hyundai Tucson
summary: Sharp styling, strong fuel economy, and a tech-forward cabin at a competitive price.
body:
The Hyundai Tucson's dramatic design departure when the current generation launched shocked a segment accustomed to conservative styling choices, and the market responded enthusiastically — the Tucson has become one of Hyundai's fastest-selling models globally. The parametric hidden lighting, the wide cascading grille, and the jewel-like LED treatment give the Tucson a visual presence that genuinely stands apart in parking lots full of lookalike competitors. The 2027 update refines rather than reinvents, with interior quality improvements and additional driver assistance features as the primary upgrades.

The powertrain lineup covers all the modern bases: a naturally-aspirated 2.5-liter for buyers prioritizing simplicity, a turbocharged 1.6-liter for those who want more performance, and a plug-in hybrid that delivers over 30 miles of electric-only range for urban commuters. Hyundai's warranty — five years bumper-to-bumper, ten years powertrain — remains the most generous coverage in the segment and is a meaningful factor in the purchase decision for value-conscious buyers. The Tucson's combination of design ambition, technical breadth, and pricing discipline makes it one of the genuinely compelling alternatives to the segment's traditional leaders.

title: 2027 Nissan Rogue
summary: Spacious cabin, intuitive tech, and a competitive price for growing families.
body:
Nissan continues to develop the Rogue into one of the segment's strongest value propositions, with each model year adding meaningful improvements without the price increases that have made several rivals harder to recommend to budget-conscious buyers. The 2027 Rogue adds standard wireless charging for both front passengers, an improved driver assistance suite that now includes rear cross-traffic braking, and a revised suspension tune that has genuinely improved the ride quality over broken pavement.

The Rogue's interior packaging remains exceptional — Nissan's engineers have found ways to maximize usable space within the compact SUV footprint that result in a cabin that feels larger than competitors with similar exterior dimensions. The available Bose audio system is particularly well-suited to the Rogue's interior acoustics, delivering a sound stage that rewards quality music in a way that most OEM audio systems fail to achieve. For families navigating the balance between what they need and what they can afford, the Rogue consistently delivers an answer that doesn't require significant compromise.

title: KTM 890 Adventure
summary: Built for the long haul with serious off-road capability and rally-bred DNA.
body:
KTM's 890 Adventure occupies the sweet spot of the adventure touring segment — large enough to carry serious loads across vast distances, agile enough to tackle genuine off-road terrain without making you question your life choices. The 889cc parallel-twin engine is one of the finest powerplants in the adventure category, producing 105 horsepower with a character that feels alive across the entire rev range rather than just at the peak. The exhaust note has a crackling, purposeful quality that sounds like what it is: a rally-bred engine in a road-legal package.

KTM's off-road credibility — built across decades of Dakar victories and enduro championships — is baked into every design decision on the 890 Adventure. The WP Apex suspension front and rear is tuned to handle both high-speed highway work and the unpredictable nature of rough trails, with adjustable preload and damping allowing significant customization for different riders and loads. The 23-liter fuel tank extends the effective range to over 300 miles between fuel stops — critical for adventure riders exploring areas where gas stations are suggestions rather than certainties.

title: Google Pixel 9 Pro
summary: Google's finest camera phone yet with pure Android and powerful AI tools.
body:
Google's Pixel 9 Pro represents the most refined expression of what happens when a company controls both the hardware and the software that runs on it. The Tensor G5 chip is designed specifically to power Google's AI features with an efficiency that Apple and Qualcomm both take note of — on-device processing of complex tasks happens without the latency that cloud-dependent alternatives introduce. The pure Android experience, updated to Android 16, remains the most logically organized and consistently updated smartphone OS available.

The camera system is the Pixel's headline feature, and rightfully so. Computational photography has been Google's competitive advantage since the original Pixel, and the 9 Pro's 50MP primary sensor paired with Google's latest processing algorithms produces images that consistently rank among the best from any smartphone. The addition of an 8x periscope telephoto — previously exclusive to Samsung and Apple's top models — closes the zoom gap that was the Pixel's most significant camera limitation. Seven years of guaranteed OS and security updates make the Pixel 9 Pro a genuinely long-term investment.

title: Unitree GD01
summary: A rideable, wall-smashing mecha robot that turns science fiction into a production-ready reality.
body:
Unitree's GD01 isn't a humanoid assistant or a warehouse quadruped — it's something stranger and more ambitious: a manned, transformable mecha robot that the company bills as the world's first mass-produced platform of its kind. Where most of the industry is racing to build robots that work alongside humans, Unitree built one you climb inside of, echoing decades of anime and science fiction rather than the industrial-automation playbook everyone else is following.

The GD01 walks upright, carries a human operator, and can reportedly smash through walls, showcasing raw actuator power and structural durability rather than delicate manipulation. Unitree has been careful to frame it as a civilian platform, urging owners to operate it safely, even as observers note the obvious crossover into defense and heavy-duty applications. It arrives against the backdrop of Unitree's remarkable ascent: the company now controls roughly 70% of the global quadruped robot market and shipped more humanoid units in 2025 than any other manufacturer, including Tesla.

While most buyers today are universities, research labs, and developers rather than factories, the GD01 signals where Unitree wants to take the conversation next — from robots that do labor to robots that amplify human strength and presence directly. It's less a practical tool for 2027 and more a statement of intent about what's coming after.

title: NVIDIA RTX Spark
summary: Nvidia's first laptop superchip fuses a Blackwell GPU with an ARM CPU to build a true agentic AI machine.
body:
For three decades Nvidia has been the company that sold the graphics card inside someone else's laptop. With RTX Spark, unveiled at Computex 2026, that changes. This is Nvidia's own system-on-a-chip for Windows machines — a Blackwell RTX GPU paired via NVLink-C2C with a 20-core Grace CPU, delivering up to a petaflop of on-device AI compute and as much as 128GB of unified memory. It's Nvidia building the equivalent of Apple Silicon, aimed squarely at machines like the MacBook Pro.

The pitch isn't just raw horsepower, it's a philosophical shift in what a laptop is for. Nvidia is positioning RTX Spark as hardware for 'personal AI agents,' with Microsoft co-developing new OS security primitives so on-device agents can run safely and persistently rather than phoning home to the cloud. Adobe is rebuilding core Photoshop and Premiere workflows to be fully GPU-accelerated for the platform, and Nvidia says gaming performance holds up too, with roughly 100 FPS at 1440p expected across current AAA titles.

ASUS, MSI, Dell, HP, Lenovo, and Microsoft's own Surface Laptop Ultra are among the first RTX Spark machines confirmed, arriving fall 2027 with prices estimated between roughly $2,500 and $7,000 depending on configuration. The Surface Laptop Ultra stands out as the flagship showcase, pairing the chip with a 15-inch mini-LED display hitting 2,000 nits — the brightest Surface screen yet. Whether RTX Spark actually reshapes how people use Windows laptops, or simply becomes a very fast niche machine for a small set of power users, is the open question heading into launch.

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 & Fold8 Ultra
summary: Samsung splits its flagship foldable into two tiers, adding an Ultra model built for serious multitasking.
body:
For the first time, Samsung's book-style foldable comes in two flavors. The standard Galaxy Z Fold8 leans into everyday usability — at 201 grams it's the lightest Fold Samsung has ever made, built around a new Flex Titanium display structure and a 4:3 inner panel shaped for video, games, and split-screen work. It runs the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy chip and a 4,800mAh battery, with the main display reaching up to 3,000 nits.

The Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra is the more significant story: it's the first Ultra-branded model in the Z series' history, and it exists specifically for people who push their foldable hard. It pairs an 8-inch main display with a bigger 5,000mAh battery, 45W dual-path charging designed to distribute power more efficiently, and an expanded graphite cooling structure meant to keep performance steady during editing, multitasking, and sustained AI workloads — the exact scenarios where thin foldables have historically struggled with heat.

Both phones layer in agentic AI that can review and act on multitasking suggestions with user approval, part of Samsung's broader push to make the inner display feel like a genuine productivity tool rather than a novelty. Pricing reflects the new tier: the Fold8 starts at $1,899.99, while the Fold8 Ultra starts at $2,099.99. Pre-orders are open now, with general availability landing August 7, 2027.

title: 2027 Honda Accord
summary: The benchmark midsize sedan returns with more refinement, power, and tech than ever.
body:
Honda's Accord has been the automotive journalist's default midsize sedan recommendation for decades, and the 2027 model does nothing to disrupt that consensus. The Accord's engineering philosophy has always prioritized the driving experience over raw specification numbers, and the result is a car that feels more alive and engaging behind the wheel than the segment typically demands. The turbocharged 1.5-liter in the base trim and the 2.0-liter in Sport and Touring variants both deliver power with a linear, predictable character that rewards driver engagement.

The hybrid variant deserves particular recognition — Honda's two-motor system achieves 46 MPG combined while providing genuinely satisfying performance, a combination that previously required accepting significant compromises. The interior has been upgraded with premium materials throughout, a new 12.3-inch touchscreen with Google Built-In integration, and a Bose audio system that is genuinely impressive for a factory installation. Honda Sensing 3.0, now standard across the entire range, represents one of the most capable and reliable driver assistance suites in the segment. The Accord isn't exciting — it's better than that.

title: PFL New York: Nurmagomedov vs. Colgan
summary: Unbeaten lightweight champion Usman Nurmagomedov defends his title against a wrestler many believe could be his kryptonite, as Dakota Ditcheva finally returns to the SmartCage.
body:
PFL New York caps a three-week stretch of consecutive world title main events with arguably the toughest test yet for PFL Lightweight World Champion Usman Nurmagomedov, who takes his perfect 28-0 record — built on wins over former champions Patricky Pitbull and Benson Henderson — into a defense against unbeaten NCAA Division I wrestler Archie Colgan (13-0). Colgan has developed through LFA, Bellator, and PFL without dropping a round, and represents the kind of live-wrestling threat that has given elite strikers trouble across the sport. With longtime training partner Islam Makhachev no longer occupying the UFC's lightweight throne, speculation continues to swirl around Nurmagomedov's future, adding extra intrigue to this title defense.

The co-main event marks the long-awaited return of top-ranked flyweight Dakota Ditcheva (15-0), who faces former Bellator kickboxing champion Denise Kielholtz after injury forced her out of an earlier scheduled date. It's Kielholtz's first MMA appearance since 2023 and her promotional debut following the PFL's absorption of Bellator. The event marks the PFL's first visit to New York since 2023 and streams from UBS Arena in Belmont Park, with prelims at 7:00 PM ET on the ESPN app and the main card following on ESPN.

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8
summary: Samsung's clamshell foldable gets its thinnest, lightest redesign yet, built around AI on the cover screen.
body:
While the Fold8 chases productivity, the Galaxy Z Flip8 is chasing something different: portability and personality. At 6.1mm thick when unfolded and 180 grams, it's the thinnest and lightest Flip Samsung has ever released, and most of the meaningful upgrades live on the outside of the phone rather than inside it.

The redesigned FlexWindow — Samsung's cover display — now runs edge-to-edge and surfaces Now Brief updates, notifications, and AI tools without requiring the phone to be opened at all. Gemini Intelligence can be triggered directly from the side key or by voice, letting supported tasks run while the phone stays folded shut in a pocket or bag. It's a clear bet that for Flip owners, glanceable AI matters more than a large unfolded screen.

The camera system gets creator-focused attention too: a 50-megapixel main sensor powered by Samsung's ProVisual Engine, paired with new Camcorder Grip and Super Steady with Horizontal Lock modes, plus Dual Recording that captures both the creator and their subject at once. The Z Flip8 starts at $1,199.99, with pre-orders open now and general availability beginning August 7, 2027.

title: BKFC 90: Henry vs Lane
summary: BKFC heads to Birmingham UK as Bryce Henry and Julian Lane toe the line in a massive bare knuckle showdown at Utilita Arena.
body:
BKFC's visit to Birmingham brings bare knuckle boxing to one of England's most enthusiastic combat sports cities, and the arena setting — larger than most BKFC events — reflects the promotion's confidence in the UK market's appetite for the format. Bryce Henry is a methodical and technically sound bare knuckle fighter who controls fights through high volume and ring generalship. Julian Lane is everything Henry is not — explosive, unpredictable, and capable of ending a fight with a single exchange.

The stylistic contrast between these two men is what BKFC main events are built for. Lane's nickname, "Let's Get It On," is less a catchphrase than an accurate description of his fighting philosophy, and his willingness to engage regardless of the tactical wisdom has produced some of bare knuckle boxing's most dramatic moments. Birmingham's combat sports crowd will be fully invested from the opening bell, and the Utilita Arena's atmosphere should provide the kind of backdrop that elevates both fighters' performances.

title: Bivol vs. Eifert
summary: Dmitry Bivol defends his WBA, IBF and WBO Light Heavyweight titles against Michael Eifert in Ekaterinburg, Russia.
body:
Dmitry Bivol is one of boxing's most complete champions — a fighter whose technical sophistication, physical athleticism, and championship pedigree place him among the sport's elite pound-for-pound talents. His combination of precise boxing, intelligent ring generalship, and a left hand that has ended conversations at the highest level makes him a uniquely difficult assignment for any challenger. Defending on home soil in Ekaterinburg adds a psychological dimension that experienced champions know how to channel productively.

Michael Eifert enters the biggest fight of his career with credentials that cannot be dismissed — his record against quality opposition has been built carefully, and his physical profile is well-suited to the demands of a twelve-round world title fight at light heavyweight. Bivol's three belts represent the division's most complete collection of hardware, and the champion will be motivated to make a statement that reinforces his position among boxing's best active fighters. This is the kind of world title defense that reminds you why the light heavyweight division has historically produced the sport's most technically accomplished champions.

title: Foster vs. Ford
summary: WBC title fight at the Fertitta Center in Houston, Texas.
body:
The Fertitta Center in Houston provides a world-class stage for a WBC title fight that the boxing community has been anticipating with genuine enthusiasm. Houston has a proud boxing tradition and a passionate fan base that turns out in force for significant fights, creating the kind of atmosphere that elevates performances and produces memories that last. The WBC title on the line gives both fighters concrete, career-defining stakes attached to every round.

Both men bring uncompromising styles and records that have been built against credible opposition — neither fighter is stepping into this title shot having been fed a soft path. The tactical battle will be fascinating to follow across twelve rounds, with the momentum shifts that title fights inevitably produce making this the kind of contest that rewards those who watch with full attention. Houston's boxing history includes some of the sport's greatest nights, and Foster vs. Ford has the potential to add its name to that distinguished list.

title: RAF 09: Steveson vs Romanov
summary: Real American Freestyle heads to Dallas as Gable Steveson takes on Alexandr Romanov in the main event, plus Colby Covington vs Chris Weidman.
body:
Real American Freestyle's ninth event is its most ambitious card yet, combining the world of elite freestyle wrestling with combat sports crossover matchups that generate mainstream attention. Gable Steveson's transition from Olympic gold medalist to professional combat sports is one of the sport's most compelling storylines — his physical gifts are extraordinary, and the question of whether those attributes translate against an experienced professional opponent in Alexandr Romanov gives the main event genuine intrigue.

The co-main event pairing of Colby Covington and Chris Weidman brings two former UFC title challengers into the RAF format, adding MMA credibility to a card that already has significant wrestling pedigree. Dallas is the right venue for this — the city's sports culture is broad and passionate enough to embrace a crossover event that doesn't fit neatly into any single combat sports category. RAF 09 is positioned as the promotion's breakthrough mainstream moment, and the star power assembled for Dallas gives it a real chance to deliver on that promise.

title: UFC Fight Night: Medić vs. Rodriguez
summary: Serbian welterweight Uroš Medić gets a hometown showcase as the UFC makes its historic debut in Belgrade.
body:
UFC Fight Night 283 marks the promotion's first-ever event in Serbia, landing at Belgrade Arena on August 1, 2026, with local favorite Uroš Medić headlining in front of a hometown crowd against veteran American welterweight Daniel Rodriguez. Medić, known for his heavy hands and finishing instincts, gets the platform of a lifetime to make a statement in the 170-pound division, while the well-traveled Rodriguez looks to play spoiler on enemy turf. The card carries real stakes beyond the main event too: a light heavyweight rematch between former KSW and UFC champion Jan Błachowicz and Bogdan Guskov headlines the supporting bouts, originally slated for UFC 328 before Błachowicz withdrew injured, plus a heavyweight clash between Marcin Tybura and Aleksandar Rakić and another heavyweight bout pitting Ante Delija against Johnny Walker.

The rest of the lineup is stacked with international talent looking to make their mark, including Ludovit Klein vs. Tofiq Musayev at lightweight and Dusko Todorović vs. Robert Valentin at middleweight. As the UFC's historic first trip to Serbia, this card carries extra emotional weight for the local fanbase and represents the promotion's continued push into new European markets. The event streams entirely on Paramount+, with prelims at 12:00 PM ET and the main card following at 3:00 PM ET.

title: Jake Paul's MVP Acquires PFL
summary: Most Valuable Promotions merges with the Professional Fighters League, setting up a direct challenge to the UFC's dominance in MMA.
body:
Jake Paul and Nakisa Bidarian's Most Valuable Promotions (MVP) has completed a landmark merger with the Professional Fighters League (PFL), instantly transforming the boxing-focused promotion into a combined combat sports company with a roster of nearly 400 fighters across boxing and MMA. The deal follows MVP's surprise entry into MMA earlier this year, when a Netflix-streamed card featuring Ronda Rousey, Gina Carano, Francis Ngannou, Nate Diaz, and Mike Perry drew tens of millions of viewers and validated Paul and Bidarian's ambitions beyond the boxing ring.

Under the new structure, the combined organization will operate under the MVP name, with the PFL brand expected to fully migrate to MVP MMA over the coming months as the deal closes out through 2027. PFL CEO John Martin stays on to run the MMA side as CEO and board member, while Bidarian continues to oversee MVP's boxing operations, and Paul leans on his massive social following to drive fighter exposure and fan growth. The merger brings in established PFL champions and contenders — including names like Usman Nurmagomedov, Johnny Eblen, Cris Cyborg, and Dakota Ditcheva — while keeping existing broadcast relationships with Netflix, ESPN, and Sky Sports intact. The move positions the new company as the most serious challenger to UFC dominance that MMA has seen in over a decade.

title: BMW Puts Figure 03 Humanoids to Work
summary: BMW's Spartanburg plant expands its humanoid robot program, moving Figure AI's newest robot into real logistics work on the factory floor.
body:
BMW Group is expanding its use of humanoid robots at its Spartanburg, South Carolina plant, deploying Figure AI's newest Figure 03 robot into Hall 52, one of the facility's assembly and logistics halls. The move follows an 11-month pilot of the earlier Figure 02 model, which handled sheet-metal part insertion for welding and supported production of more than 30,000 BMW X3 vehicles without incident — proof, according to Figure AI CEO Brett Adcock, that humanoids are no longer lab experiments but a workable part of a flexible manufacturing workforce.

Figure 03 is being assigned a logistics sequencing task: picking parts from larger, unsorted containers and organizing them into sequencing trolleys before they reach the assembly line, a job that demands perception, dexterous grasping, mobility, and cart handling all in the same workflow. BMW frames the deployment as part of its broader iFACTORY strategy, which pairs the humanoid rollout with digital twins, virtual 3D simulation, and AI-assisted planning across Hall 52 — the same hall slated to eventually build BMW's fully electric iX5. The Spartanburg push is part of a larger $1.7 billion investment in South Carolina and comes as analysts have sharply raised their forecasts for the humanoid robot market, now projecting global shipments approaching 50,000 units in 2026, up from an earlier estimate of 17,500.

title: 2027 Ford F-150
summary: America's best-selling truck delivers capability, comfort, and innovation in every trim.
body:
The Ford F-150 has been America's best-selling vehicle for 49 consecutive years, and the 2027 model maintains that position by continuing to offer the broadest range of capabilities, configurations, and powertrains of any truck in the segment. The aluminum-alloy body, introduced over a decade ago and still controversial among traditionalists, has proven its worth in terms of weight savings, fuel economy improvement, and corrosion resistance. The interior on upper Platinum and Limited trims rivals luxury SUVs for material quality and technological sophistication.

Ford's BlueCruise hands-free driving technology — available on most trims — represents the most capable driver assistance system in the full-size truck segment, functioning on over 130,000 miles of pre-mapped divided highways. The Pro Power Onboard system, which turns the truck into a mobile generator with up to 7.2kW of exportable power, has become a genuine differentiator for contractors, outdoor enthusiasts, and emergency preparedness-minded buyers. The F-150's towing capacity of up to 14,000 pounds with the available 3.5-liter PowerBoost hybrid V6 remains class-competitive. America's truck remains America's truck for very good reasons.

title: O'Leary vs. Chamberlain: IBO Title Defense
summary: Dublin's unbeaten super lightweight star makes the first defense of his world title in front of a hometown crowd against a dangerous southpaw.
body:
Pierce O'Leary defends his IBO super lightweight title for the first time against Mark Chamberlain at the 3Arena in Dublin, a rematch of a fight that was originally scrapped in March when Chamberlain withdrew through illness. O'Leary, a nine-time Irish amateur champion, used that setback to his advantage — stopping late replacement Maxi Hughes in the fifth round to claim the vacant belt in his first professional appearance in his home city, an event that sold out well in advance. He enters unbeaten at 19-0 with 11 knockouts, ranked in the top ten by the WBC, IBF, and The Ring at 140 pounds.

Chamberlain, a southpaw from Waterlooville, brings real danger to the assignment — 12 knockouts in 17 wins and a reputation as one of Britain's more destructive operators at the weight, though he hasn't fought since a majority draw with Jack Rafferty last August. Both the WBC's No. 5 and No. 12 contenders at 140 pounds meet with a genuine eliminator on the line: the winner moves closer to a world title shot, the loser goes back to the drawing board. O'Leary vs. Chamberlain streams live on DAZN from Dublin, Ireland.

title: Usman Nurmagomedov
summary: Usman Nurmagomedov closes out his PFL contract with a statement knockout, then puts new promoter Jake Paul on notice: pay up, or watch him walk to the UFC.
body:
Usman Nurmagomedov continued his perfect run at PFL New York, blasting through previously-undefeated challenger Archie Colgan in the first round to retain his lightweight championship. The champion staggered Colgan with a head kick before finishing him with a flurry of uppercuts, prompting referee Keith Peterson to wave it off at 3:42 of round one. The win pushed Nurmagomedov's record to an untouched 22-0 (1 NC), continuing a reign that has left the 155-pound division searching for answers.

The timing made the victory even bigger than the finish itself — this was the final fight on Nurmagomedov's PFL contract, thrusting him into free agency at the peak of his powers. With new PFL owner Jake Paul standing cageside as part of the promotion's freshly announced MVP-PFL merger, Nurmagomedov used his post-fight platform to fire a direct shot across his own boss's bow, needling MVP for its constant trash talk about UFC CEO Dana White's fighter pay while daring the new ownership to prove they'll actually deliver bigger money.

That single moment turned a routine title defense into a genuine crossroads story. Nurmagomedov now holds every card: stay in a PFL freshly backed by Jake Paul's promotional muscle and cash, betting that MVP's ambitions to challenge the UFC translate into a life-changing payday, or walk into the UFC's stacked lightweight division to chase the kind of legacy-defining fights that only Dana White's roster can offer. Whichever path he takes, one thing is clear — at 22-0, Usman Nurmagomedov isn't chasing competition anymore. He's negotiating from a position almost no free agent in combat sports has ever had.

title: 2027 Chevrolet Silverado 1500
summary: A full-size truck built tough with a refined interior and serious towing muscle.
body:
The Chevrolet Silverado 1500 is the F-150's most credible challenger in the full-size truck segment, offering a driving experience that many buyers prefer for its more traditional truck character — the Silverado rides on a full steel body that delivers a solidity and confidence that aluminum alternatives don't quite replicate. The available Duramax diesel produces 277 horsepower and 460 lb-ft of torque, making it the preferred powertrain for serious towers, while the turbocharged 2.7-liter four-cylinder is the efficiency leader for everyday driving.

The interior has taken significant strides in recent model years, with the available Super Cruise hands-free driving system now matching Ford's BlueCruise in both capability and mapped highway coverage. The High Country and LTZ trims offer a premium experience that competes genuinely with luxury truck alternatives that cost substantially more. Chevrolet's trailering technology package — including a 15-camera surround view system and integrated trailer brake controller — makes towing a large boat or fifth-wheel trailer dramatically less stressful. The Silverado is the truck for buyers who want their capability delivered with confidence rather than novelty.

title: 2027 Lamborghini Urus SE
summary: Lamborghini's super SUV goes all-in on hybrid power, dropping every non-electrified option for 2027.
body:
For 2026, Lamborghini simplified the Urus lineup down to a single choice: the Urus SE.
