The non-hybrid Urus S and the track-focused Urus Performante have both been discontinued, meaning every Urus built from here forward runs a twin-turbo 4.0-liter V8 paired with an electric motor, producing a combined 789 horsepower and 701 lb-ft of torque. It's not a softening of the formula — Lamborghini is calling it the natural next step for a super SUV that's already the brand's best-selling model by a wide margin.

The numbers back up the aggression: 0-60 mph in 3.4 seconds, an eight-speed automatic, standard all-wheel drive, and a 25.9-kWh battery good for roughly 35 miles of pure-electric range on a four-hour home charge. A visual refresh brings a new 'floating' hood design, matrix LED headlights, a reworked front bumper and grille, and a redesigned rear diffuser and taillamp treatment inspired by past Lamborghini supercars like the Gallardo. Underneath, air suspension can lift the ride height roughly three inches for off-road modes, and the SE adds 48-volt active anti-roll bars, torque-vectoring rear differential, and rear-wheel steering — aero updates alone boost rear downforce by 35% and brake cooling by 30% over the outgoing Urus S.

Demand hasn't slowed down for any of this. Lamborghini has consistently sold out Urus production a full year or more in advance, and a sharper, more track-focused Urus Performante variant — this time built on the SE's hybrid platform rather than a pure-combustion setup — is expected to arrive as a 2027 model, reportedly pushing past 800 horsepower to become the brand's most powerful SUV yet.

title: Generalist's GEN-1 Learns a Thousand Hands
summary: A single foundation model now controls everything from five-fingered hands to power screwdrivers, hinting at truly general-purpose robot intelligence.
body:
Generalist AI has expanded its GEN-1 embodied foundation model to work across a huge range of robot end effectors — from anthropomorphic five-fingered hands to specialized tools like tongs, spatulas, and power screwdrivers. The company argues this is a meaningful step toward general-purpose robot intelligence: rather than training a separate model for every hand or gripper a robot might use, a single base model can learn universal sensorimotor representations that transfer across radically different ways of physically interacting with the world.

GEN-1 is pretrained on more than half a million hours of real interaction data spanning roughly 9,000 end-effector variations, and Generalist says it can even measure how much a new tool teaches the model by tracking how far its internal weights shift during fine-tuning — a whisk, for instance, reshapes far more of the model's sensor-processing than a simple peeler does, since the model has to learn the whisk's thin wire geometry from scratch. In testing, the model has shown signs of creative problem-solving beyond its training, including coordinating both of a robot's hands to solve a task that was never explicitly taught. Generalist frames the work as evidence that the shape of a robot's hand may soon matter less than the intelligence driving it, much like how training large language models on many languages produces more capable, transferable systems.

title: Yamaha YZF-R7
summary: Supersport DNA meets everyday usability in Yamaha's middleweight track weapon.
body:
The Yamaha YZF-R7 answers a question that the sportbike market had been asking for years: what would happen if you took the proven CP2 engine from the MT-07, wrapped it in genuine MotoGP-inspired aerodynamic bodywork, and tuned the whole package for enthusiastic street and track use? The answer is one of the most exciting middleweight motorcycles of the current generation — a machine that looks like a race replica and rides with a accessibility that transforms intimidating performance into genuine fun.

The R7's chassis is a revelation in how good a mid-displacement sportbike can feel — the Deltabox aluminum frame gives the bike a rigidity and cornering precision that communicates exactly what the front tire is doing at all times, building confidence rapidly for riders who want to push. Yamaha's electronics package is appropriately calibrated for street use without being so intrusive that it disconnects the rider from the experience. At a price point well below the top-tier supersports, the R7 makes a compelling case that you don't need 200 horsepower to have an extraordinary time on two wheels.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI Continues to Dominate Gaming's Conversation
summary: Rockstar's long-awaited open-world blockbuster remains the industry's defining release, with players still uncovering new details across Leonida.
body:
Few games have managed to hold the industry's attention the way Grand Theft Auto VI has. Months after launch, Rockstar's newest open-world epic continues generating discussion through player discoveries, community-created content, and the sheer scale of its recreation of the fictional state of Leonida. Rather than fading after release, the game has settled into the same long-term cultural relevance that kept Grand Theft Auto V thriving for well over a decade.

The biggest talking point remains the world itself. Vice City returns with dramatically expanded neighborhoods, surrounding wetlands, coastal highways, rural communities, and bustling commercial districts that feel convincingly alive throughout the day. Improved pedestrian routines, denser traffic systems, dynamic weather, and countless random encounters make exploration rewarding even when players ignore the main story. Rockstar's attention to environmental detail has led countless players to spend hours simply driving, boating, or walking through the world looking for hidden references and unexpected events.

Technically, Grand Theft Auto VI represents one of the most impressive achievements of the current console generation. Character animation, facial performance capture, lighting, and physics have all taken noticeable steps forward, helping story missions blend cinematic presentation with player freedom. Vehicles feel heavier and more realistic than in previous entries, while upgraded AI gives police pursuits and combat encounters greater unpredictability.

Online discussion has also remained unusually active thanks to Rockstar's continued support and the enormous streaming community surrounding the game. New strategies, easter eggs, speedruns, and role-playing scenarios appear almost daily, ensuring that even experienced players continue finding reasons to return. Few modern releases inspire this level of community engagement months after launch.

Grand Theft Auto VI has become more than just another successful sequel. It has established itself as the benchmark for modern open-world design, setting expectations that will likely influence developers throughout the remainder of this console generation.

title: NEURA Opens a Gym for Robots in Aachen
summary: NEURA Robotics partners with RWTH Aachen University to build a 3,000-square-meter facility purpose-built for training real-world robot intelligence.
body:
NEURA Robotics has partnered with Germany's RWTH Aachen University to establish NEURA Gym RWTH Aachen, the latest site in its growing global network of Physical AI training facilities. Set to open at the university's Hightech Campus Melaten by the end of 2026, the roughly 3,000-square-meter facility is built to tackle what NEURA calls the biggest bottleneck in intelligent robotics: the scarcity of real-world training data. Unlike large language models, which can train on trillions of text data points, robots have access to only a fraction of that volume of physical-world experience — and NEURA argues that simulation alone can't capture the friction, variability, and unpredictability robots need to learn from.

The Aachen site is one of ten NEURA Gyms currently in development, with five expected to be operational across Europe, the U.S., and China by the end of 2026, backed by NEURA's Series C funding of up to $1.4 billion — the largest ever raised by a full-stack robotics company. About 20 RWTH institutes will be integrated into the facility, giving both large enterprises and mid-sized companies a place to validate humanoid and industrial robots for real production workflows in manufacturing, automotive, the circular economy, and medical technology before full deployment. Data collected at the gym will feed directly into NEURA's Neuraverse, its cloud-based platform connecting robots, developers, and industry partners.

title: 2027 Chevrolet Silverado 1500
summary: Chevy's full-size pickup gets a styling refresh and wider hands-free tech availability for 2026, holding steady ahead of a full redesign.
body:
The 2027 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 leans into evolution rather than reinvention, arriving as a bridge model ahead of an all-new generation expected for 2027. The biggest visual change is up front: slimmer, more aggressive LED headlights and a bolder grille borrowed stylistically from the heavy-duty Silverado lineup give the truck a more commanding presence, paired with new wheel designs and two additional exterior colors, White Sands and Polar White TriCoat.

Mechanically, the four-engine lineup carries over unchanged: a 2.7-liter TurboMax four-cylinder (310 hp, 430 lb-ft), a 5.3-liter V8 (355 hp), a 6.2-liter V8 (420 hp), and a 3.0-liter Duramax turbo-diesel (305 hp, 495 lb-ft) that returns close to 28 mpg highway. Max towing across the lineup tops out at 13,300 pounds. The 6.2-liter V8 also picks up an optional Sport exhaust calibration, delivering a more aggressive tone in Sport mode on RST, Trail Boss LT, LTZ, and High Country trims, with the ZR2 getting it as standard.

On the tech side, GM's Super Cruise hands-free driving system expands to more trims — LT, RST, LT Trail Boss, LTZ, ZR2, and High Country. Towing tech also improves, with upgraded camera systems adding better trailer views and blind-zone alerts, and the truck now supports over-the-air software updates so owners can get new features and fixes without a dealer visit. A new RST Select Package brings 20-inch gloss-black wheels, all-terrain tires, a spray-on bedliner, and assist steps, while a dealer-installed Realtree Appearance Package returns for Custom and Custom Trail Boss trims.

title: BKFC Fight Night Hollywood: Soto vs Deleon
summary: Bare knuckle action comes to the Hard Rock Hotel in Hollywood Florida as Tony Soto takes on JC Corazon Deleon.
body:
The Hard Rock Hotel in Hollywood, Florida is a venue that understands how to host a spectacle, and BKFC's decision to stage a Fight Night there reflects the promotion's growing confidence in its ability to fill premium event spaces. Tony Soto has been one of BKFC's most reliable main event performers, combining the technical qualities that succeed in the bare knuckle format — precise punching, smart defense, and the ability to manage distance — with the durability that turns competitive fights into decisive victories.

JC Corazon Deleon brings a style that is fundamentally different from Soto's measured approach — aggressive, forward-moving, and willing to accept punishment in order to land his own shots. The Hollywood crowd, known for its enthusiasm and its appreciation for dramatic moments, will be engaged from the first exchange. Bare knuckle fights on the Florida coast have a particular energy, and BKFC's Fight Night format — leaner card, focused matchmaking — tends to produce the promotion's most consistently entertaining events.

title: Samsung Galaxy S25+
summary: Bigger screen, longer battery, and all the AI smarts of the S25 lineup.
body:
The Samsung Galaxy S25+ occupies the sweet spot of the Galaxy S25 family — larger than the standard S25 without the extreme dimensions and price of the Ultra, it delivers the full Samsung AI experience in a form factor that is genuinely comfortable for most hands. The 6.7-inch Dynamic AMOLED display is spectacular, with deep blacks and vibrant colors that make content consumption — whether streaming, gaming, or photography review — a genuinely pleasurable experience. The Snapdragon 8 Elite chipset ensures that nothing in daily use presents any performance challenge.

Battery life is the S25+'s most practical advantage over the standard model — the larger cell, combined with efficient chipset and display optimization, delivers a full day's use with meaningful headroom remaining for most users. Samsung's Galaxy AI features — Circle to Search, Live Translate, Generative Edit — are available in full on the S25+, giving buyers access to the complete AI ecosystem at a more accessible price than the Ultra commands. If you want the best Samsung experience without the Ultra's S Pen premium, the S25+ is the answer.

title: Nintendo Switch 2 Gives Developers More Room to Grow
summary: Nintendo's latest console is allowing studios to build larger, smoother experiences while preserving the hybrid design players love.
body:
Nintendo's Switch 2 has quickly become one of the most important gaming platforms of the current generation, providing developers with significantly more capable hardware while maintaining the portable-and-home-console flexibility that made the original Switch such a massive success. Rather than abandoning its winning formula, Nintendo has refined nearly every part of the experience while giving studios the performance needed to create more ambitious games.

The biggest improvement comes from the additional power under the hood. Developers can now create larger environments, more detailed characters, improved lighting systems, and smoother performance without the compromises that were common on the original Switch. Third-party publishers have shown renewed interest in the platform, bringing experiences that previously required major reductions or were unavailable entirely.

Nintendo has also focused on improving the everyday experience. Faster loading times, a sharper display, better storage options, and improved system performance make the console feel like a natural evolution rather than a completely different product. The ability to continue playing existing Switch titles has helped create a smoother transition for longtime Nintendo fans while allowing the new hardware to build its own library.

The company's approach remains different from competitors. Instead of competing directly through raw specifications, Nintendo continues prioritizing accessibility, portability, and unique gameplay experiences. That strategy has attracted a wide range of developers, from major publishers looking for a massive audience to independent studios seeking a platform where creative ideas can stand out.

With a growing lineup of new releases and stronger third-party support, Switch 2 appears positioned to continue Nintendo's momentum. The system demonstrates that the company's greatest strength has never been chasing hardware trends — it has been creating platforms where players want to spend their time.

title: Xbox Series X/S Price Hikes
summary: Prices jump as much as 71% starting August 1 — is the Xbox still worth it?
body:
Microsoft's decision to raise prices on the Xbox Series X and Series S by as much as 60% and 71% respectively marks one of the steepest console price increases in recent memory. A 1TB Xbox Series X now runs $799.99, nearly $300 above its original launch price, while the Series S climbs to $599.99. The hikes are being attributed to ongoing RAM and GPU shortages rattling the entire hardware industry, not just Xbox.

For shoppers weighing a purchase, the calculus has shifted meaningfully. The Series S, once the budget-friendly entry point into current-gen gaming, now sits far closer to what the Series X used to cost — undercutting its own value proposition. We break down whether waiting, buying used, or looking at PlayStation and Nintendo alternatives makes more sense given where console pricing stands heading into the back half of 2027.

title: PFL Charlotte: Battle vs. Rosta
summary: Two middleweights coming off tough losses to the same man look to salvage their championship hopes in the PFL's return to Charlotte.
body:
PFL Charlotte headlines with a rebound fight loaded with stakes: No. 8-ranked Bryan "The Butcher" Battle takes on No. 4-ranked Dalton "Hercules" Rosta, both looking to bounce back after brutal setbacks at PFL Pittsburgh in March. Battle, who signed with PFL after a UFC run that saw him go 7-1 with one no contest, fell to former champion Johnny Eblen by first-round submission in his organizational debut. Rosta suffered his own first-round knockout loss on the same card, this time to Impa Kasanganay. Whoever comes out ahead here plants their flag back in the thick of a middleweight picture that just crowned its interim champion.

The Bojangles Coliseum card runs deep, with PFL tournament finalist Josh Silveira taking on former Bellator title challenger Aaron Jeffery, and Josh Fremd meeting Jhony Gregory in another key 185-pound clash. It marks the promotion's second visit to Charlotte and first since PFL 9 in August 2025. PFL Charlotte streams live on ESPN, with prelims at 7:00 PM ET and the main card at 10:00 PM ET.

title: 2027 Ford Explorer
summary: A three-row SUV that balances family practicality with genuine driving enjoyment.
body:
The Ford Explorer has been the defining three-row family SUV for over three decades, and the 2027 model demonstrates that longevity is earned through continuous improvement rather than resting on heritage. The rear-wheel-drive-based architecture gives the Explorer a driving dynamic that genuinely sets it apart from most family haulers — the steering is communicative, the body control through corners is confident, and the available ST performance variant transforms the concept of a three-row SUV into something that enthusiast drivers can genuinely appreciate.

Practicality remains the Explorer's core mission, executed with Ford's typical clarity of purpose. The third row is more accessible and comfortable than many competitors, folding flat with a single action to reveal a cargo floor that extends usefully when full passenger capacity isn't required. The available 400-horsepower EcoBoost V6 in the ST trim provides effortless acceleration that makes merging on the highway with a full load of passengers and gear feel like a non-event. Ford's Co-Pilot360 safety suite is comprehensive and well-calibrated, with lane keeping and adaptive cruise performing reliably in real traffic conditions.

title: Zuffa Boxing 10: McKenna vs. Oliha
summary: Zuffa Boxing makes its historic first visit to Ireland, headlined by a middleweight world title fight in front of a home crowd in Dublin.
body:
Zuffa Boxing 10 marks the promotion's debut event in Ireland, headlined by a middleweight world title bout between Ireland's Aaron McKenna and Italy's Etinosa Oliha over 12 rounds at the 3Arena in Dublin. It's a significant milestone for Dana White and Turki Al-Sheikh's boxing venture, which has rapidly built out a touring schedule across the U.S., UK, and now Ireland since launching in 2025 — and a chance for McKenna to become a world champion on home soil in front of a crowd that will be firmly behind him.

The rest of the card is stacked with additional world-level action: Callum Walsh takes on Tyler Denny and Sam Hickey meets Brad Axe at middleweight, Joe Ward battles Artjom Kasparian at light heavyweight, and Patrick O'Connor faces Ibrahim Mercan at cruiserweight. Zuffa Boxing 10 streams live on Sky Sports in the UK and Ireland and exclusively on Paramount+ in the U.S. and Canada.

title: 2027 Kia K5
summary: Fresh off a 2025 mid-cycle refresh, Kia's midsize sedan carries into 2027 largely unchanged.
body:
The 2027 Kia K5 is a carryover model, following a substantial refresh for the 2025 model year that already brought the sedan up to date. That 2025 update introduced a new standard engine, a facelifted exterior with Kia's Star Map LED lighting signature, distinctive amber zigzag daytime running lights, new wheel designs, and a standard 12.3-inch infotainment screen with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto.

Like its smaller sibling the K4, the K5 wears a fastback silhouette. The lineup carries a naturally aspirated 2.5-liter four-cylinder as the standard engine across most trims, while the GT retains its turbocharged 2.5-liter four-cylinder paired with an eight-speed wet dual-clutch automatic for stronger performance. All-wheel drive remains limited to the GT-Line. Exterior color choices include black, gray, and white on the base trim, with red and blue options opening up on higher trims.

With no major mechanical or styling changes for 2026, the K5 continues to lean on last year's refresh to compete in the midsize sedan segment, offering a modern tech package and distinctive styling without asking buyers to wait for something newer.

title: PFL + BKFC Blood 4 Blood
summary: PFL and BKFC collide in a crossover event built for hardcore combat sports fans.
body:
Professional Fighters League and Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship's crossover event represents one of the more creative promotional concepts in recent combat sports history — two organizations with distinct identities and loyal fan bases combining their respective rosters for a card that offers genuine variety within a single evening of competition. For hardcore combat sports fans, the prospect of watching PFL-caliber MMA alongside BKFC's raw intensity on the same card is genuinely compelling.

The crossover format creates interesting promotional dynamics: BKFC fighters who might not otherwise draw MMA audiences get exposure to PFL's viewership, while PFL events gain the visceral intensity that bare knuckle action brings to any card it appears on. The matchmaking for crossover events like this typically produces some of the most interesting stylistic experiments in combat sports, as fighters from different promotional cultures and training philosophies meet in formats that neither fully owns. Blood 4 Blood has the potential to be one of 2027's most memorable combat sports events.

title: Glory 108: RISE World Series Tokyo
summary: Glory and RISE collide in Tokyo for a spectacular night of world class kickboxing at the Ota City General Gymnasium.
body:
Glory Kickboxing's collaboration with RISE — Japan's premier kickboxing promotion — is one of the sport's most significant international partnerships, bringing two organizations with distinct stylistic cultures into competition under a single roof in Tokyo. Glory's European fighters bring a precise, technical approach built on years of competing under rules that reward clean striking and tactical discipline, while RISE's Japanese representatives carry a domestic tradition of relentless forward pressure and spectacular finishing that Tokyo audiences respond to with particular fervor.

The Ota City General Gymnasium is a storied combat sports venue that has hosted some of Japan's most significant kickboxing nights, and its intimate dimensions create an atmosphere where the crowd's energy amplifies every exchange. Tokyo kickboxing events have a ceremonial quality that elevates competition — the walkouts, the announcements, the crowd's synchronized appreciation of particularly skillful moments create an experience that is distinctly Japanese and genuinely unlike any other combat sports environment on earth. Glory 108 promises to honor that tradition.

title: UFC Vegas 120: Gamrot vs. Salkilld
summary: A veteran lightweight contender chasing a title run collides with the division's hottest undefeated prospect at the UFC Apex.
body:
UFC Vegas 120 headlines with a genuine crossroads fight in the stacked lightweight division: No. 8-ranked Mateusz Gamrot puts his championship aspirations on the line against No. 12-ranked Quillan Salkilld, the Perth product riding a 12-fight winning streak into his first UFC main event. Gamrot, a former two-division KSW champion, has clawed his way back into contention with a recent submission win over a top contender, and a victory here would mark another step toward a return to the title picture in one of the sport's deepest weight classes. Salkilld, who earned his UFC spot through Dana White's Contender Series, has been nothing short of ruthless since arriving — three straight first-round stoppages, each good enough for a post-fight bonus.

The rest of the Meta APEX card is loaded with momentum-building action: Diego Ferreira meets Billy Quarantillo at lightweight, Amanda Lemos returns at strawweight against Alexia Thainara, and heavyweights Steven Asplund and Guilherme Pat collide in a striking clash few will want to blink through. UFC Vegas 120 streams live on Paramount+ from Las Vegas, Nevada, with prelims at 5:00 PM ET and the main card at 8:00 PM ET.

title: RIZIN Landmark 14: Ougikubo vs Takahashi
summary: Japan's premier MMA promotion heads to Sendai as flyweight champion Hiromasa Ougikubo defends his title against Makoto Takahashi in a highly anticipated rematch.
body:
RIZIN has built its identity on producing the kind of moments that Japanese combat sports fans have celebrated for decades — technical excellence combined with the genuine drama that title fights and personal rivalries naturally produce. The flyweight rematch between Ougikubo and Takahashi is exactly the kind of matchup that RIZIN's format is built to showcase: two domestic stars with a history, a title on the line, and a passionate Sendai crowd invested in the outcome from the opening bell.

Hiromasa Ougikubo is one of Japan's most technically accomplished active champions, combining elite grappling with a striking game that has developed significantly since the first meeting. Makoto Takahashi's desire for redemption gives him a motivational edge that rematches uniquely provide — he knows exactly what he needs to do differently and has had the time to prepare for it. Sendai's combat sports culture is fervent and knowledgeable, and the crowd's appreciation of technical excellence will reward both fighters for their best performances. RIZIN Landmark 14 is a championship night that Japan's MMA scene has been building toward.

title: Zuffa Boxing 7: Billam-Smith vs. Rozicki
summary: The first Zuffa Boxing event outside the US, live from Bournemouth International Centre in England, featuring Chris Billam-Smith defending against Ryan Rozicki.
body:
Zuffa Boxing's decision to stage its seventh event at the Bournemouth International Centre marks a significant expansion milestone — the first time the promotion has taken its brand of premium boxing outside American borders, and the choice of Chris Billam-Smith's home territory is both strategically astute and narratively perfect. Billam-Smith is one of British boxing's most likable champions, a fighter whose journey to the top of the cruiserweight division has been characterized by technical improvement, genuine heart, and the kind of personality that makes casual fans into passionate supporters.

Ryan Rozicki arrives as a genuine threat rather than a promotional opponent — the Canadian cruiserweight has developed into one of the division's most dangerous punchers, and his power travels comfortably from training camps to championship fights. Bournemouth will be energetically behind their local champion, creating an atmosphere that Zuffa Boxing events have consistently used to create memorable televised spectacles. The promotion's international debut deserves a performance that sets the stage for further European expansion.

title: ONE Samurai 2: Noiri vs. Liu
summary: The ONE Samurai Featherweight Kickboxing Tournament begins in Tokyo, headlined by a highly anticipated rematch between former interim champion Masaaki Noiri and China's Liu Mengyang.
body:
ONE Championship returns to Tokyo for the second installment of its monthly ONE Samurai series, emanating live from Ebara Wave Arena Ota on Saturday, August 8. The event marks the beginning of the ONE Samurai Featherweight Kickboxing Tournament, featuring eight of the division's elite strikers. In the quarterfinal headliner, former ONE Interim Featherweight Kickboxing World Champion Masaaki Noiri seeks redemption against China's Liu "Spirit Dragon" Mengyang in a rematch of their explosive first encounter. The co-feature sees former SHOOT BOXING Champion Kaito Ono face Iranian brawler Mohammad Siasarani in their own highly anticipated sequel.

ONE Samurai 2 continues the promotion's commitment to the Japanese market following the landmark debut of ONE Samurai 1 at Ariake Arena in April, which delivered a night of thrilling action across MMA, Muay Thai, kickboxing, and submission grappling. The event streams live and exclusively on live.onefc.com.

title: Steam Remains the Heart of Modern PC Gaming
summary: Valve's digital platform continues to define PC gaming through its massive library, community features, and constant evolution.
body:
Steam has transformed from a simple digital storefront into the foundation of modern PC gaming. More than two decades after its launch, Valve's platform remains the central destination for players looking to discover new releases, build massive libraries, and connect with gaming communities around the world. Its continued success comes from a combination of accessibility, developer support, and features that have become essential parts of the PC experience.

One of Steam's greatest advantages is the diversity of its catalog. Major publishers, independent studios, early-access developers, and experimental creators all share the same marketplace, allowing games of every size to find an audience. While blockbuster releases continue driving attention, many of gaming's most successful smaller titles have grown through Steam's recommendation systems, community reviews, and player-driven discovery tools.

Valve has also continued expanding Steam beyond a traditional store. Cloud saves, controller compatibility, Remote Play, family sharing, workshop support, and community features have made the platform an ecosystem rather than simply a place to purchase games. User-created modifications in particular have helped extend the lifespan of countless titles, keeping communities active years after launch.

The platform's seasonal sales remain some of the biggest events on the gaming calendar, giving players opportunities to discover overlooked games while helping developers reach new audiences. For smaller studios, visibility during these events can make a significant difference, often turning promising releases into long-term successes.

As PC gaming continues growing through powerful hardware, handheld computers, and broader cross-platform releases, Steam remains the standard that competitors measure themselves against. Its combination of flexibility, community, and long-term support has made it one of the most influential platforms in gaming history.

title: Best Smartwatch Bands Under $20
summary: Refresh your watch's look without spending big — our favorite budget bands.
body:
You don't need to spend flagship-watch money to change up how your smartwatch looks and feels on your wrist. The budget band market has matured significantly, and there are now genuinely well-made silicone, nylon, and woven options available for under $20 that rival first-party bands in comfort and durability.

We rounded up standout picks compatible with Apple Watch, Galaxy Watch, and Pixel Watch, focusing on breathability for workouts, quick-release mechanisms for easy swapping, and styles that go from gym to office without looking out of place. A few surprise picks from lesser-known brands punch well above their price point, proving you don't need to pay a premium to keep your smartwatch looking fresh.

title: 2027 Mazda CX-5
summary: Premium feel, sharp handling, and a beautifully crafted interior set the CX-5 apart.
body:
The Mazda CX-5 has consistently been the automotive critic's favorite in the compact SUV segment — a vehicle that prioritizes driving feel, interior craftsmanship, and genuine quality over the feature-count arms race that characterizes many of its competitors. The G-Vectoring Control Plus system, which makes subtle torque adjustments to improve cornering stability and steering feel, gives the CX-5 a dynamic quality that no other compact SUV at its price point can match. This is a car that rewards attentive drivers with feedback and involvement that the segment typically withholds.

The interior design philosophy draws from Mazda's Kodo design language and applies it with exceptional consistency — the horizontal dashboard architecture, the restrained use of controls, and the premium materials throughout create an environment that feels genuinely Japanese in its understated sophistication. The Turbo variant's 227-horsepower output is delivered through an exceptionally well-calibrated powertrain that makes the CX-5 feel genuinely quick without being rowdy. For buyers who would rather have a car that is beautiful and engaging to drive than one stuffed with maximum specifications, the CX-5 is the honest answer.

title: 2027 Chevrolet Trax
summary: An affordable, stylish, and surprisingly spacious subcompact SUV for urban adventurers.
body:
The Chevrolet Trax's reinvention for the current generation was one of the automotive industry's more surprising success stories — a vehicle that had been a forgettable entry-level SUV became, almost overnight, one of the segment's most compelling and well-designed offerings. The exterior styling is genuinely bold for a Chevrolet product at this price point, and the interior punches so far above what the subcompact SUV class typically offers that first-time buyers frequently express surprise at what they're getting for the money. The 11-inch infotainment touchscreen is standard, and the available wireless charging and heated seats are features that used to require stepping up to a significantly more expensive vehicle.

The 137-horsepower turbocharged three-cylinder is genuinely adequate for urban and suburban use, though buyers who regularly carry passengers on highway trips will find it working hard when the road rises or the load increases. Fuel economy averages 32 MPG combined, which is competitive for the class. The Trax's standout quality is its value density — no other subcompact SUV at its transaction price delivers as much design, space, and technology per dollar. For urban buyers who need an SUV's elevated seating position and cargo flexibility without a premium price, the Trax is an easy recommendation.

title: J&J's OTTAVA Surgical Robot Wins FDA Clearance
summary: A table-integrated surgical robot from Johnson & Johnson gets the green light to challenge Intuitive Surgical's decades-long grip on the OR.
body:
The FDA has granted Johnson & Johnson's OTTAVA Robotic Surgical System De Novo authorization, making it the world's first table-integrated soft-tissue robotic surgery platform to reach the U.S. market. Rather than relying on a separate cart or ceiling-mounted boom like most surgical robots, OTTAVA builds four robotic arms directly into the operating table itself, cutting the system's footprint by 30-50% compared to traditional setups. That extra space matters more than it sounds: it lets surgical teams move freely around the patient and opens robotic surgery up to operating rooms that were previously considered too cramped to support it.

The system is cleared for a range of general surgery procedures, including gastric bypass, gastrectomy, cholecystectomy, and hernia repair, and features a "twin motion" capability that lets the table and arms move in sync, so a patient can be repositioned mid-procedure without breaking the workflow. OTTAVA now enters a market long dominated by Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci system, which has more than 8,000 units installed worldwide, alongside more recent challengers from Medtronic and CMR Surgical. Some analysts remain skeptical that a smaller footprint alone will be enough to shake loose Intuitive's deep relationships with surgeons and hospitals, but J&J is betting that OTTAVA's flexible design and openness to third-party data and automation tools will carve out real share over time.

title: 2027 Land Rover Defender
summary: A mid-cycle refresh brings a bigger touchscreen, new lighting, and the debut of the urban-focused Vertex trim across the Defender lineup.
body:
Five years into its current generation, the Land Rover Defender receives a substantial mid-cycle refresh for 2026, touching every version from the compact two-door 90 up through the family-oriented 130. The most noticeable interior change is a new 13.1-inch touchscreen running updated Pivi Pro software, replacing the outgoing model's standard 10-inch (or optional 11.4-inch) display. Land Rover also relocated the dashboard-mounted gear shifter for better ergonomics, reworked the center console with a new hidden storage compartment, and added a driver-facing camera that monitors attention to the road. A new AI-powered 'Hey Land Rover' voice assistant lets drivers control vehicle functions with natural speech rather than fixed commands.

Outside, changes are deliberately subtle in keeping with the Defender's boxy heritage look: new LED headlight graphics, now-standard fog lights, flush-mounted smoked taillights, restyled front and rear bumpers, and a gloss-black grille bar with a darkened badge. Two new paint colors join the palette — Woolstone Green and Borasco Grey — bringing the total range to 15 options, including a new Namib Orange shade. New 22-inch seven-spoke wheels are also available.

The headline addition is the Defender Vertex, a new urban-focused variant sitting alongside the existing Defender X, distinguished by a larger front grille, redesigned bumper, gloss-black spoiler, body-colored cladding, yellow brake calipers, and standard 22-inch Satin Dark Grey alloy wheels. The Defender 110 also gains a first-ever six-seat interior layout. On the capability side, Adaptive Off-Road Cruise Control debuts across the lineup, and Land Rover is offering an optional built-in air compressor for on-the-go tire adjustment, exclusive to the 130. The performance-focused Defender Octa returns as well, picking up a new Woolstone Green color option alongside the rest of the range's styling updates.

title: Rizin 54: Japan GP Heavyweight Semifinals
summary: Four heavyweights enter Tokyo with a shot at Rizin's first-ever heavyweight title on the line, as the Japan GP tournament reaches its semifinal round.
body:
Rizin 54 hosts the semifinal round of the RIZIN Japan GP Heavyweight Tournament, a bracket built to crown a challenger for the promotion's brand-new inaugural heavyweight championship. Confirmed participants Mikio Ueda, Tsuyoshi Sudario, and King Edokpolo square off against one another and a still-unconfirmed fourth entrant, with the two winners advancing straight to the tournament final in November. Whoever ultimately claims the bracket earns a New Year's Eve date with Alexander Soldatkin for the title itself — giving every fight on this card genuine championship weight rather than just tournament advancement.

The rest of the Toyota Arena Tokyo lineup is headlined by a featherweight clash between Kleber Koike Erbst and Kyoma Akimoto, adding another high-stakes storyline to a card built entirely around elimination stakes. Rizin has spent 2027 rapidly expanding its footprint across Japan, and the heavyweight tournament represents its biggest structural bet yet: a division with no history in the promotion, built from scratch through a single-night gauntlet. Rizin 54 streams live via Internet PPV from Kōtō, Tokyo, Japan.

title: BMW S1000RR
summary: The ultimate superbike. Race-bred technology meets road-legal fury in BMW's flagship.
body:
BMW's S1000RR is the benchmark against which all other superbikes are measured — a machine that translates from World Superbike Championship racing into a road-legal motorcycle without diluting the core competencies that make it extraordinary on track. The 999cc inline-four engine produces 210 horsepower in standard trim, with the optional M Package pushing that figure to 215 horsepower through the addition of lighter titanium connecting rods and high-performance engine components. The power delivery is explosive in a way that demands respect but is made accessible by one of the most sophisticated electronics suites in motorcycling.

BMW's ShiftCam technology — variable valve timing and lift on the intake camshaft — gives the S1000RR an unusually broad power curve for a race-bred superbike, with usable torque available from low revs and the full high-rpm fury reserved for when the rider requests it. The M Endurance Chain, M Carbon wheels, and M GPS lap trigger are available for riders who want to extract the maximum from their machine on a closed circuit. On the street, the S1000RR is simultaneously terrifying and reassuring — a motorcycle that communicates so clearly and responds so precisely that experienced riders quickly build the confidence to enjoy its full potential.

title: The Future of Gaming Handhelds Gets More Competitive
summary: Portable gaming continues expanding as manufacturers push for stronger performance, better displays, and more console-like experiences.
body:
The handheld gaming market has entered one of its most competitive periods ever, with players no longer limited to traditional portable consoles. Powerful handheld PCs, upgraded gaming systems, and new hybrid devices have created a category that combines the convenience of portable play with performance levels that were once impossible outside a desktop setup.

The success of devices like the Steam Deck and other portable gaming PCs has changed expectations for what handheld hardware can deliver. Players now expect high-resolution displays, strong battery management, comfortable controls, and the ability to access large libraries across multiple storefronts. Manufacturers have responded by improving processors, cooling systems, and software experiences to create devices that feel increasingly close to full gaming computers.

Battery efficiency remains one of the biggest challenges. Unlike traditional consoles designed around fixed hardware, handheld PCs must balance performance with portability. Advances in chip design have helped narrow that gap, allowing newer devices to provide better graphics quality without sacrificing the freedom that makes handheld gaming appealing.

The growth of this category has also influenced game development. More studios are optimizing their titles for portable systems, creating experiences that scale smoothly between desktop monitors, televisions, and smaller screens. Features like cloud saves and cross-platform progression have made it easier than ever for players to continue their games wherever they are.

The next stage of handheld gaming will likely focus on refinement rather than reinvention. Better displays, longer battery life, improved operating systems, and wider software support will determine which devices succeed. What is clear is that portable gaming has moved beyond a niche market and become one of the industry's most important areas of growth.

title: PS5 Pro's 2027 Graphics Update
summary: Sony promises a major performance boost is coming to the PS5 Pro.
body:
According to the PS5's lead architect, Sony is preparing a significant graphics update for the PS5 Pro in 2027 that could meaningfully improve rendering performance without requiring new hardware. Details remain limited, but early signals point to improvements in ray-tracing efficiency and frame-pacing consistency — two areas where the Pro has faced criticism since launch.

For owners who already invested in the premium console, this update could finally deliver on some of the performance promises made at launch. We look at what's been confirmed so far, what remains speculation, and whether this changes the calculus for anyone still deciding between the standard PS5 and the Pro model heading into a pivotal stretch of major game releases.

title: Apple iPhone 17 Pro
summary: A powerhouse camera system and A19 Pro chip in a lighter, more refined titanium body.
body:
Apple's iPhone 17 Pro is the non-Max Pro model done to near perfection — a device that captures the vast majority of the iPhone 17 Pro Max's capabilities in a form factor that fits comfortably in a single hand without the wrist fatigue that extended use of larger phones produces. The titanium chassis has been further refined for 2026, with a new surface treatment that holds its appearance through daily use better than previous generations. The A19 Pro chip's performance is indistinguishable from the Max variant in every real-world scenario, and the battery improvements mean a full day's use is achievable even for demanding users.

The camera system is where the Pro's story becomes particularly interesting — the same 48MP primary and ultrawide sensors as the Max variant, with a 5x periscope telephoto that covers the majority of photography scenarios most users encounter. ProRes video recording at 4K 120fps opens professional-grade footage possibilities for filmmakers who want a compact camera. Apple Intelligence features are identical to the Max, meaning the complete suite of AI tools is fully available. For buyers who want the Pro's complete feature set without the Max's size and price, the iPhone 17 Pro is the decision that requires no second-guessing.

title: Mistral Ships Its First Robot Brain
summary: Robostral Navigate lets robots follow spoken directions through offices and warehouses using nothing but one ordinary camera.
body:
Mistral AI has entered the robotics world with Robostral Navigate, its first model built specifically for embodied navigation. The 8-billion-parameter model takes a single RGB camera feed and a plain-language instruction — something like walking through a lobby, down a corridor, and stopping at a particular shelf — and autonomously carries out the full route, including through live spaces with people and obstacles it's never encountered before. What makes it notable is what it doesn't need: no LiDAR, no depth sensors, no array of multiple cameras, all of which have historically been considered necessary for reliable robot navigation.

On the R2R-CE benchmark, a standard test for instruction-following navigation, the model hit a 76.6% success rate on scenes it had never seen before, beating the best single-camera system by nearly 10 points and even outperforming systems using depth sensors or multiple cameras. Mistral trained the model largely in simulation and says it's still climbing with more training, calling this a first step toward a single, unified model that can handle navigation across office buildings, homes, and outdoor spaces. The company is positioning it for use in manufacturing, delivery, logistics, and hospitality, and says it's now expanding its robotics team to build on top of it.

title: 2027 Dodge Ram 1500
summary: The HEMI is back. Ram's full-size pickup brings its beloved 5.7-liter V8 out of retirement for 2026, alongside new trims and a plug-in hybrid option.
body:
After retiring the HEMI V8 for the 2025 model year in favor of the twin-turbo Hurricane inline-six, Ram is reversing course for 2027: the 5.7-liter HEMI V8 eTorque returns as an available engine, now paired standard with a GT Performance Exhaust. It joins the two states of tune of the 3.0-liter Hurricane inline-six that debuted last year, giving buyers a three-engine spread once again. Towing and payload figures have also nudged up slightly across the lineup, with max towing reaching into the 11,000+ pound range depending on configuration.

The biggest powertrain news, though, is the new Ramcharger — a plug-in hybrid setup pairing a 3.6-liter Pentastar V6 with a battery and two electric motors for a combined 647 horsepower and 610 lb-ft of torque, routed through standard four-wheel drive. It's Ram's answer to buyers who want serious power without giving up a gas engine as backup range extension.

Trim-wise, 2027 adds both the Express — a blacked-out, value-focused trim slotting above the Tradesman — and the BackCountry, a new off-road model splitting the difference between the Big Horn and Rebel. The BackCountry starts at $62,410 and comes with a one-inch suspension lift, upgraded dampers, skid plates, front tow hooks, an electronic locking rear differential, and 18-inch wheels wrapped in 32-inch off-road tires. Inside, the cabin gains a larger 14.5-inch Uconnect 5 touchscreen, a 10.25-inch front-passenger display, and an optional 23-speaker Klipsch Reference Premiere sound system, along with continued availability of class-exclusive features like active-leveling air suspension and the RamBox cargo management system.

title: 2027 Kia Sportage
summary: Bold design, a driver-focused cockpit, and strong value make the Sportage a standout.
body:
Kia's Sportage has undergone one of the automotive industry's most dramatic redesigns in recent memory, transforming from a competent but visually conservative compact SUV into one of the segment's most striking and talked-about vehicles. The exterior design — particularly the distinctive tiger-nose grille and the complex surfacing of the bodywork — generates genuine attention in a segment where standing out from the crowd is genuinely difficult. The interior is equally bold, with a curved dual-screen display system spanning the driver's zone in a way that feels purposefully futuristic without being difficult to use.

Under that styling is a thoroughly capable package: the turbocharged 1.6-liter four-cylinder produces 180 horsepower with a smooth power delivery, and the available plug-in hybrid version delivers 34 miles of electric range alongside combined fuel economy that makes it one of the most practical PHEV compact SUVs available. Kia's 10-year powertrain warranty remains the industry's most generous coverage commitment, and the brand's improvement in interior material quality over recent generations has been remarkable. The Sportage is the SUV for buyers who want to arrive somewhere and have the car noticed.

title: The Rise of Live-Service Games Continues to Shape the Industry
summary: Publishers are investing heavily in games designed to evolve for years, changing how players experience and support their favorite titles.
body:
Live-service games have become one of the most influential trends in modern gaming, changing the way developers create, update, and support their projects. Instead of ending when players complete a campaign, these games are designed as evolving platforms with regular content updates, seasonal events, new characters, expansions, and community-driven changes.

The appeal for publishers is clear. Successful live-service titles can maintain large player communities for years while providing developers with opportunities to continue improving the experience. Games such as competitive shooters, online role-playing games, and multiplayer action titles have demonstrated that a strong community can become just as important as the original launch itself.

However, the market has also become more challenging. Players now have more choices than ever, and maintaining attention requires consistent updates and meaningful improvements. A successful live-service game needs more than frequent cosmetic additions — it must provide engaging gameplay, respond to player feedback, and create reasons for audiences to return.

Developers have increasingly focused on building stronger relationships with their communities. Public test servers, detailed roadmaps, developer updates, and direct communication have become common strategies for maintaining trust. Players expect transparency, especially when games rely on long-term support and ongoing investment.

The future of live-service gaming will likely depend on quality rather than quantity. While publishers continue exploring the model, players have shown that they will support games that respect their time and deliver meaningful experiences. The next generation of successful online games will not simply be those that last the longest — they will be the ones that give players the strongest reasons to stay.

title: ONE Fight Night 46: Carrillo vs. Zhou
summary: Fresh off claiming undisputed gold, Nico Carrillo immediately jumps sports, testing his power against a kickboxing newcomer in pursuit of two-division champion status.
body:
ONE Fight Night 46 carries a genuine changing-of-the-guard storyline into Lumpinee Stadium, as newly-crowned undisputed ONE Featherweight Muay Thai World Champion Nico Carrillo makes his promotional kickboxing debut against Chinese newcomer Zhou Jiaqiang. Carrillo, "King of the North," inherited the throne outright after Tawanchai vacated the title, capping a destructive run through the division that includes stoppages of former longtime champion Nong-O Hama and Saemapetch Fairtex. Rather than settle into a title defense, the 27-year-old Scot is stepping into an entirely new discipline just weeks after winning gold — a decision that fits a fighter whose 30-4 record and 16 finishes were built entirely on seeking out the hardest available fight.

The stakes go beyond a single win. A victory over Zhou would put Carrillo on the doorstep of two-sport World Champion status, joining an exclusive club of fighters who've held titles across multiple disciplines within the promotion. Zhou, largely unproven at this level, gets the opportunity of a lifetime: spoil a champion's crossover debut and announce himself in the same breath. The rest of the Lumpinee Stadium card features a pivotal bantamweight Muay Thai clash between Nontachai Jitmuangnon and Kiamran Nabati, both fighting to climb back into their own division's title picture.

ONE Fight Night 46 streams live on Amazon Prime Video from Bangkok, Thailand, with the main card airing at 9:00 PM ET.

title: Google Pixel 11 Series Launches
summary: Everything Google announced at Made by Google, from new chips to camera hardware.
body:
Google's 'Made by Google' event delivered exactly what was rumored: a four-phone Pixel 11 lineup built around a new-generation Tensor chipset, deeper on-device AI integration, and a redesigned camera system anchored by a distinctive Pixel Glow LED on the back. The standard Pixel 11 starts at $899, with the Pixel 11 Pro and Pro XL climbing to $1,099 and $1,299, while a Pixel 11 Pro Fold tops the lineup at $1,899.

Beyond specs, Google leaned heavily into AI-powered photography and call-screening improvements as the differentiators for this generation. We break down what's genuinely new versus iterative, how the pricing compares to last year's Pixel 10 lineup, and which model actually makes sense depending on how you use your phone day to day.

title: A Welding Robot That Walks to the Job
summary: Path Robotics straps its AI welding model onto a four-legged robot, bringing automated welding to job sites that were too big or too awkward to automate before.
body:
Path Robotics has launched Rove, a mobile robotic welding system that mounts the company's Obsidian physical AI model onto a quadruped robot, letting it walk directly to a workpiece rather than requiring the workpiece be brought to a fixed welding cell. It's a meaningful shift for industries like shipbuilding, heavy construction, and large-scale fabrication, where massive assemblies and inconsistent part fit-up have long made robotic welding automation impractical — those environments simply couldn't fit a part into a traditional welding cell, even as skilled-welder shortages have made automation more urgent than ever.

Obsidian already handles adaptive, real-time welding adjustments inside fixed cells, and Rove extends that same intelligence into the field, using the legged platform's mobility to scan weld seams and adjust welding parameters on the fly in unpredictable, high-variability settings. Path Robotics CEO Andy Lonsberry frames it as proof that legged robots — long dismissed as too unstable for precision welding work — can now handle it. Saronic Technologies, an autonomous maritime vessel maker, has signed on as one of the first early adopters, testing Rove in its shipbuilding operations in Franklin, Louisiana, with broader commercial availability expected in early 2027.

title: PFL Africa 2: Nigeria Debut
summary: PFL makes history with its first ever event in Nigeria, bringing world class MMA to Lagos for a landmark night of African combat sports.
body:
Professional Fighters League's debut in Nigeria is a landmark moment for African MMA — a continent with extraordinary athletic talent and a rapidly growing fan base for combat sports finally receiving a world-class professional promotion event on its soil. Lagos is one of Africa's most vibrant and sports-passionate cities, and the reception PFL has already received in its pre-event promotional activities suggests that the appetite for elite MMA in Nigeria is substantial and ready to be served at the highest level.

The card has been thoughtfully constructed to showcase African and African-diaspora fighters prominently, giving the home crowd genuine investment in the outcomes beyond appreciation of the sport itself. Nigerian MMA has produced several fighters who have gone on to compete at elite international levels, and PFL Africa 2 will provide a platform for the next generation of those athletes to gain the exposure that professional competition at this level uniquely provides. This event is about more than one fight card — it is about establishing Nigeria as a permanent fixture in the global MMA landscape.

title: ONE Fight Night 46
summary: ONE Championship closes out the summer with another U.S. primetime event from Lumpinee Stadium, featuring North and South American talent alongside global superstars.
body: ONE Championship returns to U.S. primetime on Friday, August 15, with ONE Fight Night 46 broadcasting live from Bangkok's iconic Lumpinee Stadium. Following the momentum of ONE Fight Night 45, this card promises another thrilling night spanning MMA, Muay Thai, kickboxing, and submission grappling. The event spotlights the most exciting North and South American talent in the promotion alongside established global superstars, though specific bouts are still being finalized. ONE Fight Night 46 streams live on Amazon Prime Video at 9:00 PM ET, continuing the promotion's monthly U.S. primetime schedule that has made Lumpinee Stadium a regular destination for international fight fans.

title: UFC 330: Makhachev vs. Machado Garry
summary: Welterweight champion Islam Makhachev makes the first defense of his title against unbeaten contender Ian Machado Garry in a Philadelphia championship doubleheader.
body: UFC 330 brings the promotion back to Philadelphia for the first time since 2019 and its first numbered event in the city. Headlining the card is Welterweight Champion Islam Makhachev, who makes the first defense of his title against the unbeaten Ian Machado Garry. Makhachev, widely regarded as one of the pound-for-pound best in the sport, will look to continue his dominant reign against Garry, who has been relentless in his climb up the rankings and brings an undefeated record into the biggest fight of his career. The event promises a high-stakes championship doubleheader that will have major implications for the landscape of the welterweight division.

title: RAF 15: Tsarukyan vs. Pettis
summary: A UFC lightweight contender defends crossover gold against a former champion stepping onto the mat.
body:
Arman Tsarukyan puts his RAF middleweight crossover title on the line against Anthony Pettis in the main event of RAF 15 at NOW Arena in Chicago. Tsarukyan won the inaugural belt at RAF 14 with a 78-second technical fall over Dillon Danis and remains one of the most active crossover wrestlers in the promotion, having also competed at RAF Abu Dhabi earlier in November.

Pettis, a former UFC lightweight champion, was originally slated to face Donald Cerrone in a third MMA meeting before Cerrone withdrew. Instead, "Showtime" makes his freestyle wrestling debut against a wrestler who has been dominant on the mat. The card also features Henry Cejudo vs. Song Yadong for the lightweight crossover title and Cody Garbrandt vs. Sergio Pettis, giving the Chicago crowd a deep lineup of MMA names testing themselves in wrestling.

title: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: Israel Adesanya returns to the cage in Riyadh, desperate to halt a four-fight skid against a rising middleweight.
body:
Israel Adesanya headlines UFC Fight Night 295 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, against Sharabutdin Magomedov, a matchup that carries far more weight for the former two-time champion than for his opponent. Adesanya has not won since April 2023 and has dropped four straight, including a stoppage loss to Nassourdine Imavov in his last outing. At 37, every appearance now invites questions about whether the end is near.

Magomedov, 17-1 as a professional, has won back-to-back fights and gets his first UFC main event. "Shara Bullet" is a dangerous striker with momentum, while Adesanya is fighting to prove there is still a chapter left in his career. The stylistic contrast makes this a compelling test: Magomedov will engage, and Adesanya must find the timing and confidence that once made him untouchable.

title: PFL MENA 12: MMA's Most Wanted
summary: The PFL MENA season reaches its championship stage in Saudi Arabia with multiple title fights on the line.
body:
PFL MENA 12 takes place at the Dhahran Expo in Khobar, Saudi Arabia, with a card built around championship stakes across multiple divisions. The event, subtitled "MMA's Most Wanted," features title fights in the featherweight, lightweight, and welterweight divisions, with Mohammad Alaqraa (10-1) headlining in the welterweight main event.

The MENA series has become a key pipeline for PFL's global roster, and this card represents the culmination of the 2026 season for the region. While full opponent details remain limited in public reporting, the structure of the event makes clear that three champions will be crowned, giving regional fighters a platform to claim gold and potentially earn opportunities on the larger PFL stage in 2027.

title: PFL Africa 4: 2026 Finals
summary: Three champions will be crowned in Kigali as PFL Africa closes its 2026 season with $300,000 on the line.
body:
PFL Africa 4 lands at the BK Arena in Kigali, Rwanda, with three divisional tournaments reaching their conclusion: welterweight, lightweight, and bantamweight. Each winner takes home $100,000 and a championship belt, bringing the total prize purse to $300,000. The main event features Angola's Shido Boris Esperança (13-2) against Nigeria's undefeated David Samuel (7-0) for the welterweight title.

The card also carries significant regional weight, with Kenyan fighters Kevin Odongo (heavyweight) and Felista Mugo (women's strawweight) joined by Uganda's Isaac Omeda and a Burundian competitor, spotlighting East African talent on a continental stage. PFL Africa has positioned this as a career-defining night for the region's fighters, and the Kigali crowd will witness the biggest prize-money title event in African MMA history on East African soil.

title: UFC 335: Oliveira vs. Lopes
summary: The BMF title is on the line in Las Vegas as Charles Oliveira welcomes Diego Lopes to the lightweight division.
body:
Charles Oliveira defends the BMF championship for the first time against fellow Brazilian Diego Lopes in the main event of UFC 335 at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas. Oliveira, the UFC's all-time leader in finishes, captured the BMF belt by beating Max Holloway in March and now faces a dangerous newcomer to the 155-pound division.

Lopes built his reputation as a two-time featherweight title challenger, falling short against Alexander Volkanovski but establishing himself as one of the most aggressive and well-rounded fighters on the roster. He moves up to lightweight off a knockout win over Steve Garcia and now faces a significant step up in stakes. Oliveira's jiu-jitsu and pressure against Lopes's power and aggression makes this one of the most stylistically volatile BMF fights since the belt's creation.

title: RAF 16: Chimaev vs. Evans
summary: Khamzat Chimaev's crossover reign meets its most decorated test yet in UFC Hall of Famer Rashad Evans.
body:
Khamzat Chimaev defends his RAF light heavyweight crossover title against Rashad Evans at RAF 16 in Long Island, New York. Chimaev has been relentless in his RAF run, defeating every opponent by pin or technical fall and holding the promotion's record for fastest finish. His pressure and strength have overwhelmed everyone placed across from him.

Evans brings a different kind of résumé. A UFC Hall of Famer and former light heavyweight champion, Evans was an All-State high school wrestler, a Junior College All-American, and a two-time NCAA qualifier before his MMA career. At 47, he has not competed in combat sports since 2022, but his wrestling base and competitive experience make him a compelling stylistic contrast to Chimaev's suffocating pace. The question is whether Evans can turn the match into a positioning battle and avoid the physical mismatch that has swallowed Chimaev's previous opponents.

title: PFL Lyon: Lapilus vs. McKee
summary: France's Taylor Lapilus fights for a world title at home against undefeated American Mitch McKee.
body:
PFL Lyon crowns its first bantamweight world champion as Taylor Lapilus (25-4) meets Mitch McKee (11-0) at the LDLC Arena in Lyon-Décines. Lapilus, a former UFC fighter on a six-fight winning streak, has been dominant since joining PFL in 2025 and now has the chance to become one of France's first undisputed world MMA champions in front of a home crowd.

McKee represents a serious obstacle. A two-time All-American wrestler at the University of Minnesota and a three-time state champion, he has six knockout wins among his eleven victories and announced himself in PFL by dominating Sergio Pettis in his debut. Training under Robbie Lawler at Kill Cliff FC, McKee is a well-rounded threat with elite grappling and improving striking. For Lapilus, the pressure of fighting for gold at home is immense; for McKee, it is an opportunity to silence a French arena and take a belt back to the United States.
